added.description:
About Diffraqtion

Diffraqtion builds a novel Quantum Vision System that pulls more information out of each photon than conventional imaging allows. Our photonics process incoming light before it reaches the sensor, so the computation happens passively in the light itself. We are an early-stage team in Somerville by founders from MIT and Harvard, working under NASA and DARPA contracts and backed by Lockheed Martin and Sumitomo. Our systems are headed for satellites that protect assets in orbit and on the ground, and for telescopes hunting Earth-like planets around other stars. You would be joining early, with real hardware to build and real missions to put it on.

The Role

We are hiring a Computer Vision Engineer to build the models at the center of our Quantum Vision System. Our photonics do part of the computation in light before it reaches the sensor and your models finish it. You will own the imaging pipeline from raw sensor output to actionable detections: physics-based reconstruction and de-noising, detection and tracking, and deployment on the embedded hardware that flies. You will work directly with our optical and opto-mechanical engineers to build an end-to-end model of the imaging chain, from photons to outputs, so optics and algorithms can be optimized together. The first systems you work on are headed to space.

You have built multi-sensor fusion on real sensors and have shipped estimators and learned models that had to work on hardware, not just on benchmarks. You are comfortable with probabilistic models and deep learning in the same week. You want a problem nobody has solved yet and the hardware to test it on.

Note
: This position requires
U.S. citizenship, lawful permanent resident status, or eligibility for authorization under U.S. export control regulations (ITAR/EAR).

Key Responsibilities

Design, train, and deploy computer vision models for imaging and perception tasks like image reconstruction, detection, classification, and tracking tailored to our optical front end.
Develop de-noising and image-restoration methods (classical and learned) that are robust to sensor noise, radiation effects, low light, and optical aberrations.
Build a cohesive, end-to-end model of the imaging chain coupling physics-based optical and sensor models with neural networks to enable joint optimization of optics and algorithms.
Design and implement sensor fusion algorithms that combine camera data with other onboard sensors using probabilistic and learned approaches.
Integrate vision and fusion outputs into the system's real-time control loop, defining interfaces, latency budgets, and failure modes together with controls and embedded engineers.
Optimize and deploy models to resource-constrained edge hardware (e.g., embedded GPU, FPGA, or SoC), including quantization, pruning, and runtime profiling.
Build data pipelines and simulation tools for synthetic and lab-captured datasets, including calibration, labeling, and domain-gap analysis between simulation and hardware.
Define metrics and run hardware-in-the-loop experiments in the lab to validate algorithm performance on real sensor data.
Document designs and results clearly, and contribute to technical reviews and the team's shared codebase and best practices.

Qualifications

Required:

M.S. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering field.
3+ years of industry experience developing and deploying computer vision or perception systems on real sensors.
Hands-on experience with multi-sensor measurement fusion: combining measurements from multiple imaging or onboard sensors into one estimate or image, using probabilistic and learned methods.
Hands-on experience with computational imaging: image de-noising, restoration, or reconstruction.
Strong grounding in estimation theory and inverse problems and hands-on experience with deep learning for imaging.
Experience designing experiments that hold up: ablations, baselines, uncertainty quantification.
Strong proficiency in Python and PyTorch (or equivalent deep learning framework), with working knowledge of C++.
Solid foundation in image formation, camera models, and calibration, and in the noise characteristics of imaging sensors.
Solid software engineering practices: version control, testing, and reproducible experiments.
This an on-site in Somerville, MA, alongside the hardware team.

Background in aerospace, defense, robotics, or autonomous systems, ideally with space or airborne sensors.

Non-visible imaging (e.g., infrared, multispectral, or hyperspectral) or event-based sensors.
Publications or open-source contributions in sensor fusion, computational imaging, or computer vision.

Evaluate and implement AI-enhanced automation across QA, scheduling, and payments workflows using the UiPath platform, freeing operational capacity for higher-value donor interactions and improving decisions where accuracy has business consequences
Serve as the internal capability provider for AI features, already in production that are consumed by other product teams. Establish the patterns other engineers will adopt as AI use cases multiply across the ecosystem
Data Engineering & Feature Development
Develop and maintain feature stores and data transformation pipelines that supply high-quality, well-governed training and inference data
Partner with the Data Engineer on the shared data capability, including the Data Backbone initiative. Contribute the AI-facing requirements early so that data contracts, quality thresholds, freshness expectations, and lineage cover both classical ML training and generative AI retrieval needs
Apply data augmentation, synthetic data generation, and class balancing techniques to address data scarcity in regulated domains
Governance, Compliance & Ethics
Ensure all AI/ML solutions comply with applicable regulations including HIPAA, GDPR, and 21 CFR Part 11 for models used in GxP contexts
Document model design, training methodology, validation results, and known limitations in accordance with CSL quality and regulatory standards
Apply responsible AI principles including explainability, fairness auditing, and bias mitigation to all production models
Apply red-teaming and adversarial testing to LLM-based systems as part of the responsible AI lifecycle
Produce model cards or system cards for production AI systems, documenting intended use, evaluation results, known limitations, and safety considerations in a form that both technical and regulatory reviewers can consume
Design human oversight into AI workflows. Define where the model decides, where a human decides, escalation paths, and rejection or override mechanisms. Implement audit trails for AI decisions in regulated contexts so decisions can be reviewed and defended downstream

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent; education preferably concentrated in IT, Engineering, or Science, such as Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related quantitative field; Master's or PhD preferred
5+ years' IT experience, including specific experience in business systems analysis and in machine learning engineering, data science, or applied AI, with at least 2 years in a product or platform context
Proficiency in Python and ML libraries: scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost, and Hugging Face Transformers
Hands-on experience with cloud ML platforms: AWS SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, or Google Vertex AI
Experience building and maintaining MLOps pipelines using tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker Pipelines, or Azure ML Pipelines
Solid understanding of supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning algorithms and when to apply each
Experience shipping ML or generative AI into production in a regulated or consumer-scale environment
Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and evaluation-driven prompt development, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and agentic AI frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent orchestration).
Experience with LLM and RAG evaluation frameworks such as Ragas, LangSmith, DeepEval, or equivalent. Evaluation-driven development is a core expectation of the role
Experience with LLM observability tools such as Langfuse, Helicone, Arize AI, or WhyLabs for production monitoring of generative AI systems
Experience with guardrail frameworks (NeMo Guardrails, Guardrails AI, or equivalent) or hand-rolled equivalents for content safety, PII protection, and output validation
Working knowledge of LLM inference cost management, including token accounting, model tiering, and caching strategies
Strong SQL and data manipulation skills; experience with Spark, Pandas, or Polars for large-scale data processing
Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD for model deployment
Ability to communicate model results, limitations, and trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Skills & Experience

Prior AI or ML work in pharma/biotech, life sciences, healthcare, or a comparably regulated setting with formal model validation practice
Knowledge of responsible AI frameworks, model explainability tools (SHAP, LIME), and bias detection
Familiarity with healthcare data standards (HL7 FHIR) or regulatory validation in GxP environments
Experience with time-series forecasting, NLP for clinical or operational text, or computer vision
AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty or equivalent certification

Technical training or certification in vendor-specific technology, such as UiPath (for example, UiPath Certified Professional)

Competencies

Intellectual Curiosity — continuously explores new AI techniques and evaluates their practical applicability to business challenges
Product Mindset — prioritizes AI solutions that deliver measurable, production-ready value over academic experimentation

added.title: Senior Applied Scientist
added.description:
About The Role

Are you ready to work at the forefront of applied AI research, where your work reaches real customers instead of staying in a lab notebook?

Thomson Reuters Labs (TR Labs) is the AI Research & Development arm of Thomson Reuters. We experiment, we build, we deliver.

Our mission is to create industry-leading AI solutions for Legal, Tax & Accounting, Risk, and News Media professionals.

We systematically explore emerging AI/ML technologies, and we stay focused on real customer problems and opportunities.

The Senior Applied Scientist is an experienced scientific leader within TR Labs. In this role, you will own end-to-end applied research projects that drive product innovation in legal intelligence, tax automation, and regulatory compliance.

You will translate business challenges into technical solutions, determine feasibility, and deliver scalable AI capabilities. You will bring senior-level technical judgment to decisions about what to build, how to evaluate it, and when it is ready to ship.

You will also mentor scientists and influence technical direction within your team. This role is a step toward broader scientific leadership, and you will begin to grow and scale your impact as you go.

This is a role for someone who wants their ideas to ship. You will turn new methods into AI capabilities that customers use every day.

What You'll Do

Lead end-to-end applied research projects from early experimentation through to scalable, production-ready AI capabilities.
Drive product innovation in legal intelligence, tax automation, and regulatory compliance.
Translate business challenges into technical solutions and determine their feasibility.
Design and evaluate RAG architectures, agentic frameworks, and tool-using systems for complex professional use cases.
Apply senior-level technical judgment and rigorous evaluation to ensure solutions meet the quality bar.
Develop novel methods for complex professional domains such as medical, tax, or law.
Collaborate with cross-functional partners to deliver AI projects from concept to customer.
Influence technical direction within your team through clear communication.
Mentor scientists and help them grow.
Start to grow and scale your impact beyond individual projects.

About You

You are an experienced scientist who gets energy from turning hard business problems into working AI solutions. You are comfortable moving between research and delivery, and you can own a project from first idea to production.

You combine years of hands-on experience in modern AI with outstanding technical judgment. You are curious about the professional domains you work in, whether that is law, tax, medicine, or risk. You want to understand customers' problems well enough to solve them properly.

You work well in collaborative, cross-functional environments. You build trust through evaluation expertise and clear communication. You influence technical direction by helping the people around you succeed.

Qualifications

PhD or Master's degree with equivalent industry experience in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
5+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying production IR, NLP, ML, or GenAI systems using modern techniques.
Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end AI project delivery in collaborative, cross-functional environments.
Outstanding technical judgment and evaluation expertise.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence technical direction.
Experience developing novel methods for complex professional domains such as medical, tax, or law.
Expertise in RAG architectures, agentic frameworks, tool-using systems, or orchestration patterns.
Publications at relevant venues such as ACL, EMNLP, NAACL, NeurIPS, ICLR, SIGIR, or KDD.

This posting is for proactive recruitment purposes and may be used to fill current openings or future vacancies within our organization.

What’s in it For You?

Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

Our use of AI within the recruitment process Thomson Reuters utilizes Artificial Intelligence (AI) to support parts of our global recruitment process. Unless you opt-out, our AI system will assess the information provided by you and compare it to the requirements listed for the role, and present the result to our recruitment personnel for further review. The AI system acts as a supporting tool, but there is always a human making the decision if you will be considered for the role.

In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The base compensation range varies across locations. Eligible office location(s) for this role include one or more of the following: New York City, San Francisco, Los Angeles, and/or Irvine, CA; McLean, VA; Washington, DC. The base compensation range for the role in any of those locations is $146,800 USD - $272,600 USD. For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the base compensation range for this role is $127,400 USD - $236,600 USD. For Ontario, Canada, the base compensation range for this role is $100,000 CAD - $145,000 CAD. Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs. This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

Thomson Reuters makes reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities, including veterans with disabilities, and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. If you reside in the United States and require an accommodation in the recruiting process, you may contact our Human Resources Department at HR.Leave-Expert@thomsonreuters.com. Please note this email is not intended for general recruitment questions and we will promptly respond to inquiries regarding accommodations. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

added.description:
Your Impact at LILA

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer
to join our Applied AI group and help build the next generation of our AI-driven scientific platform. In this role, you will design and optimize the backend systems, data pipelines, and AI integrations that power intelligent, data-driven applications. You’ll work at the intersection of backend engineering and machine learning, ensuring our platform seamlessly scales and supports cutting-edge applied AI techniques such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic AI, and large language model (LLM) integration.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in bridging software engineering and applied AI—turning research into production-grade systems that drive real-world scientific discovery. If you are passionate about building performant, elegant systems that make AI useful and impactful, we would love to hear from you!

What You'll Be Building

Applied AI Integration: Design and deploy backend services and data pipelines that directly support advanced AI applications, including LLMs, RAG, and agentic frameworks.
API & Service Development: Build high-performance APIs and microservices that enable seamless integration between AI models, scientific tools, and user-facing applications.
Data Pipeline Architecture: Architect and manage scalable pipelines capable of handling structured, unstructured, and vectorized data for AI/ML workloads.
Database & Knowledge Systems: Implement and optimize SQL, NoSQL, and vector databases to support low-latency AI retrieval and inference workloads.
Cloud & Infrastructure: Leverage AWS, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation) to build robust, production-ready AI platforms.
Performance & Reliability: Diagnose system bottlenecks, optimize for cost and speed, and ensure the reliability and fault-tolerance of AI-driven workflows.
Collaboration: Partner with ML researchers, platform engineers, and scientists to translate models and algorithms into scalable, production-ready systems.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

Educational Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Backend & Data Expertise: 7+ years of professional experience building and scaling production systems, including APIs, data pipelines, and distributed services.
Programming Skills: Strong Python skills (FastAPI, Flask, Django), with solid experience in backend service development.
Databases: Proven experience with SQL, NoSQL, and vector databases; skilled in schema design, indexing, and query optimization.
Applied AI Systems: Hands-on experience integrating ML models or AI-driven workflows into production services.
Cloud & DevOps: Proficiency with AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code.
Communication & Problem-Solving: Ability to work cross-functionally with diverse teams and explain complex technical concepts to non-experts.

Bonus Points For

Scientific & Data-Intensive Domains: Experience working with life sciences, materials sciences, or other research-heavy fields.
Startup Experience: Comfort with fast-paced, iterative environments where impact and adaptability matter.

CompensationWe offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

Expected Base Salary Range: $144,000 USD - $270,000 USD

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

A Note to Agencies

Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. added.description:
About Fora

Fora is the modern travel agency
, empowering anyone with a passion for travel to build a thriving advisory business. We're modernizing the $100B+ travel agency industry by combining powerful technology, data, and community to enable thousands of entrepreneurs to build on our platform. Our business-in-a-box platform
gives travel entrepreneurs everything they need to launch and scale, from cutting-edge tools and personalized training to a vibrant community
and exclusive industry partnerships. At the heart of it all is our mission: to help the next generation of travel entrepreneurs turn their love for travel into a fulfilling career
, whether full-time or part-time. We believe that everyone, from seasoned professionals to first-time advisors, can build something both profitable and personal.

Founded in 2021 by seasoned entrepreneurs, Fora has grown steadily since, expanding to a team of 200+ full-time employees
based in downtown New York City
. In 2026,
we announced our $60 million Series D investment round
, led by Forerunner and Tactile Ventures, with continued participation from existing investors Thrive Capital, Insight Partners, and Heartcore Capital. We've also been recognized as a LinkedIn Top Startup 2024, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies 2025 and 2023, and we were most recently recognized as one of the TIME100 Most Influential Companies 2026.

We're building the first truly unified platform for all travel needs—leveraging the best of human expertise and technology to transform how people plan and book travel.

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned Senior / Staff Full Stack Engineer to help build Fora’s fast growing suite of AI-driven products and infrastructure. Our ideal candidate is someone who follows AI closely and can tell which models and frameworks are worth using and which won’t last; has built, shipped, triaged, and optimized something that uses LLMs (in production or on the side); and has experience working in ambiguity, on top of APIs and SDKs that change every few weeks.

Most travel agents can’t scale past $1M / year in business before they need to make their first hire. By giving advisors a day-one assistant to delegate entire workflows to, we believe they should be able to solo-operate $100M / year businesses. Our current focus is on building Via, an AI co-pilot built into our advisor portal. Via takes on time-consuming tasks so advisors can move faster, stay more organized, and glean insights into their business that they couldn't ever before, freeing them to do what they love: building client relationships, curating unforgettable trips, and growing their business.

This role tackles challenges across the AI stack including: Building and expanding our suite of MCP tools; tuning our agent harness and orchestration layer for quality, cost, and speed; and building evaluations and observability that let us ship changes to a non-deterministic system with confidence; and much much more.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with the team’s Product Manager and Designer to define and prioritize Fora’s Applied AI roadmap, turning ambiguous goals into shippable agent capabilities
Help design and build our MCP tooling – exposing Fora’s data and service layers through permission-aware MCP tools that agents can call on an advisor's behalf, with the proper guardrails in place so that we only ever act on the right data at the right time
Build and harden our agent orchestration – tool-calling loops, streaming responses, multi-step workflows, retries and guardrails, and the contracts between Fora’s advisor portal and the AI service
Continue improving the reliability of a non-deterministic system by designing evals, regression suites, tracing, and logging event metrics so we can measure quality, catch tool-call drift, and ship prompt, model, and tool changes with less risk
Focus on performance, latency, architecture, and clean code – advisors feel every millisecond of a streamed response and every wrong tool call
Collaborate with engineers across the company to define end-to-end solutions that span the AI services, the core Django platform, and our portal frontend
Take features from 0 → 1, owning an entire solution from design to implementation to delivery and beyond
Help establish the patterns, primitives, and best practices for Applied AI at Fora as the teams surface area grows

Requirements

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience
5+ years of experience in backend and frontend development
3+ years experience using React / Vue.js / Angular.io
3+ years experience with Python, using Django / Flask / Alternative
Experience building stateful and event-driven web applications
Experience testing web applications
High API and distributed-systems design skills, with strong fundamentals in relational databases and ORMs
Genuine curiosity and drive to go deep on applied AI – you're excited to spend your days making agents impactful, but reliable; you learn fast in a field that changes month-to-month or even day-to-day
Ability to be a team player, with strong communication and collaboration skills
An entrepreneurial mindset and comfort with ambiguity and fast iteration

Strongly Preferred

Hands-on experience shipping LLM-powered features in production – MCP tools, agentic loops, structured outputs, streaming (SSE), prompt design, retrieval, evals
Familiarity with the modern agent stack: the Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLM provider SDKs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI), and agent / eval frameworks
Experience designing evaluation and observability for non-deterministic AI systems (offline evals, LLM-as-judge, tracing, prompt / version tracking)
Daily use of AI coding tools as part of how you build
Experience with async task and streaming infrastructure (Celery, Redis, RabbitMQ, or similar)
AWS experience
Kubernetes experience

Compensation

Compensation for this role ranges from $185K to $235K + equity. Each level has a single standardized compensation figure, and the level offered is determined by performance across the interview process.

Other benefits include:

Unlimited vacation
Health Insurance (including an option completely covered by Fora HQ)
Dental & Vision Insurance
Wellhub Memberships
401k plan with company match
Commuter Benefits
Supplemental Life Insurance
Stock Options

This role is based in New York City with a hybrid WFH & office schedule (Monday, Tuesday and Thursday are our Tribeca in-office days, with flexibility for Wednesday and Friday at your preference).

Our Values

We’re forging our own path

Fora has always been about driving change within the industry. We’re not interested in maintaining the status quo.

We’re stronger together

Community is our cornerstone and collective power is our strength. We believe we can all go further when we operate together, using our combined leverage to unlock better opportunities and outcomes for our advisors, partners, and travelers.

We believe in technology

We believe technology is an answer to some of the most fundamental challenges the travel industry faces. We believe advancements in AI, bold investments in our platforms, and a world-class data infrastructure will transform the work of our advisors and our partners, while creating better travel experiences for travelers.

We’re here to serve

We operate in service of our community and believe that when they’re empowered to focus on what they do best, we all win. It’s why we relentlessly advocate for our advisors and prioritize their best interest every step of the way.

We mean business

Fora is equal parts fun, meaningful work and serious travel business. We’re unlocking opportunities for thousands of travel entrepreneurs, delivering a stream of high-quality guests at scale for our partners, and providing a superior travel experience for our travelers. It’s a better equation for the future of our industry.

WORK AUTHORIZATION

Authorization to work in the United States is required for full-time roles based in our New York City office. Fora is unable to sponsor or assist with U.S. work authorization. Roles based outside of the United States are not subject to this requirement.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Brooklyn, NY (Rent the Runway HQ)

About Us

Rent the Runway (RTR) is transforming the way we get dressed by pioneering the world’s first Closet in the Cloud. Founded in 2009, RTR has disrupted the $2.4 trillion fashion industry by inspiring women with a more joyful, sustainable and financially-savvy way to feel their best every day. As the ultimate destination for circular fashion, the brand now offers infinite points of access to its shared closet via a fully customizable subscription to fashion, one-time rental or ownership. RTR offers designer apparel and accessories from hundreds of brand partners and has built in-house proprietary technology and a one-of-a-kind reverse logistics operation. RTR has been named to CNBC’s “Disruptor 50” five times in ten years, and has been placed on Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies list multiple times.

About The Team

Data is core to our growing business and has been ingrained in the company's DNA since its founding. As a member of the Data Analytics team, you will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, Inventory, and other business stakeholders to identify opportunities where machine learning, AI, and advanced analytics can create meaningful customer and business value.

The Data Science team develops machine learning solutions, predictive models, recommendation systems, experimentation frameworks, and AI-powered capabilities that directly influence how Rent the Runway operates and how customers discover, engage with, and rent and buy inventory. Our work spans pricing optimization, inventory intelligence, personalization, predictive modeling, and intelligent customer experiences.

As RTR continues investing in Data Science and AI, the team plays a critical role in driving business performance and bringing new customer experiences to life — from intelligent pricing and inventory optimization to recommendation engines, personalized experiences, and future AI-powered products.

About The Job

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Data Scientist to independently own and deliver high-impact machine learning and optimization solutions that drive measurable business results.

While this role will initially focus heavily on pricing optimization, predictive modeling
, and inventory-related decision systems
, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to a broad range of Data Science initiatives, including personalization, recommendation systems, and AI-powered
customer experiences as business priorities evolve.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, Inventory, and business stakeholders to translate ambiguous business problems into scalable, production-ready machine learning solutions. You will take ownership of projects end-to-end, from identifying opportunities and defining the analytical approach to building, deploying, monitoring, and continuously improving models.

This is a highly hands-on individual contributor role with significant ownership and visibility. You will work closely with the Senior Data Science Manager while independently driving technical decisions, challenging assumptions, and helping shape how Data Science creates value across Rent the Runway.

We're looking for someone with strong technical expertise, business intuition, analytical rigor, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Do

Own end-to-end Data Science initiatives, from problem definition and exploratory analysis to model development, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Design, build, and optimize machine learning and statistical models that improve pricing decisions, revenue performance, inventory efficiency, and customer outcomes.
Partner closely with Finance, Inventory, and business stakeholders to develop and continuously improve pricing strategies and optimization models across our rental and resale businesses.
Analyze customer, product, transaction, and inventory data to identify opportunities where machine learning, predictive modeling, and advanced analytics can drive measurable business impact.
Develop forecasting, optimization, and predictive modeling solutions to support inventory planning, demand estimation, profitability, and other business-critical decisions.
Design and analyze experiments, A/B tests, and statistical evaluation frameworks to measure the incremental impact of Data Science initiatives.
Build, maintain, and continuously improve production machine learning models, ensuring reliability, accuracy, scalability, and ongoing business relevance.
Contribute to personalization, recommendation systems, customer segmentation, and AI-powered experiences as the team's roadmap evolves.
Partner across Product, Engineering, Finance, Inventory, and the broader Data organization to translate complex analytical solutions into scalable, production-ready capabilities.
Independently evaluate different modeling approaches, make thoughtful technical trade-offs, and communicate the reasoning behind methodological decisions.
Establish and follow best practices around model validation, monitoring, experimentation, documentation, and reproducibility.
Communicate insights, model performance, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Contribute to the technical development of the Data Science function by sharing knowledge, improving processes, and supporting a collaborative, high-performing team.

About You

Are you interested in improving and shaping the transportation industry alongside a group of intelligent and motivated people? Leidos operates the Federal Highway Administration's (FHWA) Saxton Transportation Operations Laboratory (STOL), a USDOT research lab focused on improving transportation operations, safety, mobility, and environmental impacts. STOL supports the advancement and deployment of emerging technologies, including vehicle automation and communication.

Leidos is seeking a mid-level Transportation Data Scientist to support FHWA-funded projects at the intersection of AI, data science, and transportation. You will build, deploy, and evaluate AI/ML models for applications such as vehicle load classification using weigh-in-motion (WIM) data and imagery, crash prediction for traffic management centers (TMCs), and data ecosystems for trustworthy AI. We are looking for a hands-on applied data scientist who has taken models from raw data all the way to deployment, has real experience with generative AI, and wants to apply AI to state and federal transportation problems. Transportation experience is a plus but not a requirement. We will help you learn the domain.

Because STOL is a research lab, the work also includes literature reviews, testing new methods, and contributing to technical reports. A research background is not required, but you should enjoy that part of the job.

Location: This role is based at the customer site in McLean, VA with a current hybrid plan of four days onsite.

Candidate MUST: Have lived in the United States for the three most recent consecutive years and be eligible for a Public Trust clearance.

https://careers.leidos.com/search/jobs?q=stol&ns_job_category=stol-jobs

Primary Responsibilities

Build ETL pipelines that clean, normalize, enrich, and fuse multi-source data (e.g., traffic logs, imagery, weather, and permitting records), and address quality issues such as inconsistency, sparsity, and bias.
Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML models for transportation applications, including generative AI and LLM-based solutions.
Package and deploy models into working environments, and support MLOps practices such as versioning, monitoring, and retraining.
Evaluate model performance under varied conditions, such as differing data quality, and recommend ways to improve robustness, scalability, and trustworthiness in real-world transportation settings.
Conduct targeted literature and data reviews on AI methods, datasets, and technologies relevant to freight analytics, traffic safety, and operations (e.g., sensor fusion, computer vision, and multimodal AI).
Support stakeholder outreach, including peer exchanges, workshops, and technical briefings with state DOTs, MPOs, enforcement agencies, and vendors.
Work with cross-functional teams to keep projects aligned with USDOT goals, including risk management, quality assurance, and compliance with federal standards.
Contribute to monthly progress reports, risk mitigation, and iterative model refinement based on federal feedback.

Required Qualifications

Education and experience (one of the following)

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Transportation Engineering, or a related field, plus 4+ years of relevant professional experience.
Master's degree in one of the fields above, plus 2+ years of relevant professional experience.

Relevant professional experience means non-academic, hands-on work in data science or AI/ML. Graduate research and coursework do not count toward this minimum.

Hands-on experience in “at least two of the three” core areas

Data preparation and ETL: You have built pipelines that ingest and integrate imperfect, real-world data from multiple sources, including multimodal data such as imagery, sensor data, or time series.
Model deployment: You have taken at least one model beyond a notebook and into a deployed or production setting, and you are familiar with MLOps tools and practices (e.g., Docker, MLflow, CI/CD, or cloud ML services).
Generative AI: You have personally built solutions using LLMs or other generative models (e.g., retrieval-augmented generation, fine-tuning, prompt design, or evaluating generative outputs).

Also Required

Strong Python skills and working knowledge of common ML and data libraries (e.g., PyTorch or TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy).
Solid understanding of model evaluation (e.g., precision, recall, F1, AUC), and the ability to explain why a model works, where it falls short, and how you troubleshoot it.
Clear communication skills, including technical writing and presenting AI concepts to non-technical audiences.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, research-oriented environment, with travel up to 20% for stakeholder meetings, site visits, or conference support.
Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance (requires three years of immediate residency in the US).
Legal authorization to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

Ph.D. in a related field.
Experience working with state DOTs or federal transportation agencies (e.g., FHWA, USDOT) on AI initiatives, including prototyping AI applications in ITS.
Computer vision or deep learning experience, especially with imagery or video.
Familiarity with transportation data sources (e.g., HSIS, SHRP2, NGSIM) and standards (e.g., SAE J2735 for V2X).
Experience with synthetic data generation (including GANs) or physics-informed ML.
Knowledge of federal AI governance, risk management, and equity considerations in transportation.
Experience leading AI tasks in multi-agency initiatives or contributing to communities of practice (CoPs).
Publications or presentations at AI or transportation conferences (e.g., TRB, ITS America).

What To Expect In The Interview

Our technical interviews center on your own work. Be ready to walk through a model or pipeline you personally built: the data you started with, the design choices you made, how you measured results, what went wrong, and what you would do differently. We value depth on what you have done over familiarity with every technique listed above.

When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a part of the Strategic Analytics and Modeling team within the Transformation Command Center working on Network Capital Strategy, you will lead projects to develop and perform complex AI-first and agentic modeling including statistical, analytical or advanced analytics on challenging long-term network capacity questions, aiming to "right-size" the future capacity planning needs for the multi-billion dollar investments in our Verizon Network.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll have high autonomy to create, improve, design and execute using AI for capacity simulations and optimization, in partnership with the relevant business partners, while on the lookout for new modeling techniques, evolving technologies and emerging industry trends that can improve accuracy, speed or generally quality of simulations. Your work will help ensure that the needs of the network that serves our customer has accurate capacity plans so downstream finance teams may appropriately fund budgetary requests for next-year expansion or operational network efforts.

Responsibilities Include

Working with stakeholders to develop AI, agent-based modeling, and algorithmic modeling for network elements and processes to support the 3-year capital budget.
Planning and executing the design of the new capacity model, obtaining general agreement from NCS and the business team.
Operating the model across multiple checkpoints in a year, creating a hardened deployment, documentation, and plans for future automation of the process.
Planning future upgrades to the model with alternate types of algorithms, AI science or additional input features.
Actively leveraging and piloting AI tools — including agentic workflows, LLM-assisted coding, and automated documentation/reporting — to accelerate model development, scenario testing, and stakeholder deliverables; Verizon expressly supports and encourages AI-augmented approaches to this work.
Assertively adapt and navigate roadblocks in the software development process, self-resolving issues and escalating roadblocks when appropriate.
Conducting occasional presentations to leaders and engineers to describe the nature of created systems.
Protecting invented Verizon Intellectual Property by pursuing patents when appropriate.

What We're Looking For

A passion for creativity, AI, innovation, process improvement, advanced algorithms, and best-practices of independent software design. A motivated, independent individual who can properly discern next-steps in the absence of requirements, and determine when to appropriately collaborate with the team and business partners. Proven ability to communicate technical information to technical or non-technical audiences with an understanding that each project has the ability to change millions of dollars of spend to benefit the customer's network experience.

You'll Need To Have

Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience.
Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Intermediate proficiency in Python (or R), SQL with a moderate history or portfolio of accomplished projects.
Intermediate proficiency in Alteryx or Knime.
Experience building or integrating agentic AI workflows (e.g., LLM-based agents, tool-use/function-calling pipelines, or automation frameworks like LangChain, AutoGen, or Claude/GPT-based agents) to automate data ingestion, scenario generation, or report synthesis in support of capital planning and simulation workflows.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

Degree in business intelligence and analytics, data science, engineering, computer science, mathematics or similar.
Experience in time series analysis / forecasting.
Strong experience in engineering investigations, performance optimizations, or network capacity management.
Prior experience navigating engineering budget cycles, such as funding requests for cell-site builds in a regional role.
Proven experience with gathering requirements and translating requirements to specific software practices.
Experience with data engineering.
Knowledge of cloud computing platforms e.g. Google Cloud Platform or Amazon Web Services.
Experience with high performance containerized GPU environments.
Solid foundation in mathematical optimization, prescriptive modeling, and network capacity management.
Designing, architecting, and deploying full-stack web applications and APIs—leveraging frameworks like FastAPI, custom GUIs (e.g., Flet, Marimo), and high-performance BI dashboards—to expose optimization models, streamline data ingestion, and accelerate scenario planning for non-technical leadership.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

added.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
added.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a part of the Strategic Analytics and Modeling team within the Transformation Command Center working on Network Capital Strategy, you will lead projects to develop and perform complex AI-first and agentic modeling including statistical, analytical or advanced analytics on challenging long-term network capacity questions, aiming to "right-size" the future capacity planning needs for the multi-billion dollar investments in our Verizon Network.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll have high autonomy to create, improve, design and execute using AI for capacity simulations and optimization, in partnership with the relevant business partners, while on the lookout for new modeling techniques, evolving technologies and emerging industry trends that can improve accuracy, speed or generally quality of simulations. Your work will help ensure that the needs of the network that serves our customer has accurate capacity plans so downstream finance teams may appropriately fund budgetary requests for next-year expansion or operational network efforts.

Responsibilities Include

Working with stakeholders to develop AI, agent-based modeling, and algorithmic modeling for network elements and processes to support the 3-year capital budget.
Planning and executing the design of the new capacity model, obtaining general agreement from NCS and the business team.
Operating the model across multiple checkpoints in a year, creating a hardened deployment, documentation, and plans for future automation of the process.
Planning future upgrades to the model with alternate types of algorithms, AI science or additional input features.
Actively leveraging and piloting AI tools — including agentic workflows, LLM-assisted coding, and automated documentation/reporting — to accelerate model development, scenario testing, and stakeholder deliverables; Verizon expressly supports and encourages AI-augmented approaches to this work.
Assertively adapt and navigate roadblocks in the software development process, self-resolving issues and escalating roadblocks when appropriate.
Conducting occasional presentations to leaders and engineers to describe the nature of created systems.
Protecting invented Verizon Intellectual Property by pursuing patents when appropriate.

What We're Looking For

A passion for creativity, AI, innovation, process improvement, advanced algorithms, and best-practices of independent software design. A motivated, independent individual who can properly discern next-steps in the absence of requirements, and determine when to appropriately collaborate with the team and business partners. Proven ability to communicate technical information to technical or non-technical audiences with an understanding that each project has the ability to change millions of dollars of spend to benefit the customer's network experience.

You'll Need To Have

Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience.
Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Intermediate proficiency in Python (or R), SQL with a moderate history or portfolio of accomplished projects.
Intermediate proficiency in Alteryx or Knime.
Experience building or integrating agentic AI workflows (e.g., LLM-based agents, tool-use/function-calling pipelines, or automation frameworks like LangChain, AutoGen, or Claude/GPT-based agents) to automate data ingestion, scenario generation, or report synthesis in support of capital planning and simulation workflows.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

Degree in business intelligence and analytics, data science, engineering, computer science, mathematics or similar.
Experience in time series analysis / forecasting.
Strong experience in engineering investigations, performance optimizations, or network capacity management.
Prior experience navigating engineering budget cycles, such as funding requests for cell-site builds in a regional role.
Proven experience with gathering requirements and translating requirements to specific software practices.
Experience with data engineering.
Knowledge of cloud computing platforms e.g. Google Cloud Platform or Amazon Web Services.
Experience with high performance containerized GPU environments.
Solid foundation in mathematical optimization, prescriptive modeling, and network capacity management.
Designing, architecting, and deploying full-stack web applications and APIs—leveraging frameworks like FastAPI, custom GUIs (e.g., Flet, Marimo), and high-performance BI dashboards—to expose optimization models, streamline data ingestion, and accelerate scenario planning for non-technical leadership.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits And Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

About the Company

Our hiring partner is building the first agentic AI platform designed to power multi-unit franchise success, covering the entire journey from brand discovery to portfolio management. They serve three core customer groups: prospective franchisees seeking the right opportunities, current operators automating workflows and uncovering critical insights, and established brands connecting with a qualified pipeline of ambitious partners.

Franchising is a massive, trillion-dollar industry with over 800,000 locations across the U.S. and a rapidly expanding international footprint. Multi-unit operators now control more than half of all franchise locations, yet the infrastructure required to build and scale these portfolios remains fragmented and outdated. Backed by leading investors and industry experts, this team is modernizing the ecosystem and unlocking its full potential.

About the Role

This company is seeking a Forward-deployed Engineer to operate at the intersection of engineering and customer success—building the technical integrations and customizations that ensure customers derive maximum impact from the platform and its AI agents.

This is not a traditional engineering role. This individual will work directly with customers to understand their existing systems, scope integration approaches, and define the agentic capabilities that make the platform valuable across the franchise ecosystem. Success in this role requires equal comfort jumping on a call with a customer's technical team and writing production code.

Examples of projects this engineer might work on include:
Leading technical onboarding for new brand partners by connecting their existing data, CRMs, and messaging systems to the platform, enabling them to identify high-fit franchisees and run their franchise development operations end-to-end.
Developing structured, repeatable integration layers that pull accounting, payments, and employee systems into the platform, powering portfolio management for multi-unit operators.
Extending the agent infrastructure to support customer-specific workflows, turning one-off customizations into reusable platform capabilities as patterns emerge.

What You'll Do

Own customer outcomes end-to-end—embed with customers (including onsite where needed), understand their workflows and what success looks like in the real world, and ensure the platform delivers significant, measurable value.
Lead technical discovery, solution design, and delivery for high-impact customer deployments, including data onboarding, workflow configuration, and identifying new capabilities that can drive incremental customer value.
Design, build, and maintain integrations with external partners across the franchise ecosystem.
Work directly with customers' and partners' technical teams to scope requirements, troubleshoot issues, and ensure reliable data exchange.
Partner with the go-to-market team to evaluate new partnership opportunities from a technical feasibility standpoint.
Build internal tooling and infrastructure that makes customer and partner onboarding faster and more repeatable—transforming bespoke customer solutions into reusable platform capabilities when patterns emerge.
Move quickly to prototype and ship whatever is needed to unblock a customer deployment or commercial deal.
Translate field observations into product insight, serving as one of the team's best sources of feedback on what to build next.

Who You Are

Possesses 4+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful exposure to integrations, APIs, or platform engineering.
Demonstrates strong technical skills across the stack, including comfort with TypeScript or Node.js, APIs (REST and GraphQL), SQL, databases, data pipelines, and command-line tooling.
Has experience building and maintaining integrations with third-party systems in production environments.
Is comfortable owning the full lifecycle: discovery, design, build, deploy, operate, and iterate.
Brings a customer and partner-facing mindset with the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Is resourceful and scrappy, figuring out how to work with messy, underdocumented partner APIs and imperfect data to make things work.
Embraces a high-ownership mindset, driving every customer outcome and partner integration through to completion and holding oneself accountable to a high standard.
Is naturally curious and ambitious, with a passion for going deep on new customer workflows and partner systems, and turning messy integration work into reliable infrastructure.
Has a strong bias for action, shipping and iterating quickly without waiting for perfect specifications or complete information.
Is fully "AI-native," leveraging AI coding tools to amplify personal velocity and impact. This individual is eager to work in an environment where AI is a core pillar of both the product and internal operations, even if their current company does not fully embrace it.
Prior experience in forward-deployed, solutions engineering, implementation, or technical consulting roles is a plus.
Prior experience in a startup or early-stage environment is a plus.
An interest in franchising and the local business landscape is also a plus.

Why Join the Team

Meaningful Impact:
Play a direct role in supporting local communities by empowering individual operators and elevating great franchise brands.
Ownership & Responsibility:
Own significant pieces of the business and have a direct influence on the company's strategic direction.
AI-Native Culture:
Be part of a team that is actively pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, both in their product and their internal workflows.
Benefits:
Enjoy comprehensive benefits including fully-covered healthcare options and unlimited PTO.

Collaborate daily with the founding team in a dynamic New York City office environment.

– We’re looking for an experienced, Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to help build the future of AI-powered software creation. You will be a founding member of our FDE function, working directly with our customers to translate ambitious ideas into real products.

This is a hands-on software engineering role: you will design, write, and ship production code. It’s a unique opportunity to scale a new discipline from scratch and solve problems with AI that no one has solved before.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

About The Role

You’ll build alongside customers at the frontier of what Lovable can do, solving technically difficult problems across our frontend, backend and AI systems. The goal isn’t simply to make individual deployments successful: it’s to identify what should become part of the Lovable platform and then build it.

As one of our first Forward Deployed Engineers, you’ll also help define the function - from its engineering standards and ways of working to how it collaborates with customers and our core product teams.

If you want to stay deeply hands-on while shaping a product, a team and a new engineering discipline, this is that role. As you’ll be working directly with customers, travel up to 50% could be required depending on needs.

added.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

As an Applied AI Engineer on the Startups team at Anthropic, you will be a trusted technical advisor to the top AI-native startups building in the physical world, across robotics, semiconductors, aerospace, manufacturing, and civil infrastructure, as they grow from early product to scale. Some of these companies build the hardware itself and want Claude woven into how they design, test, and operate it, and others build the software that engineers everywhere use to design, simulate, test, and scale, and this role works with both. You'll lead deep technical engagements, partnering directly with startup software and hardware engineering teams to help them build their products on Claude and run their own engineering with it, advising on implementation and agent design as they build what is newly possible with AI in the physical world. You will bridge the gap between what Claude can do and what it takes to build real things, working alongside some of the strongest teams in the field on problems that matter and helping mechanical, electrical, and process engineers get the kind of step change that software engineering has had from agentic coding with tools like Claude Code.

Working closely with Applied AI Architects, Account Executives, and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams, you'll help startups build at the edge of what is possible with Claude. You'll leverage your AI engineering expertise and your engineering domain knowledge to develop custom evaluation frameworks, design scalable architectures, and create the technical resources that enable physical AI startups to succeed with Claude.

Responsibilities

Serve as a deep technical advisor to high-potential startups building in the physical world, whether Claude sits inside the product they sell or inside the way they design, test, and run their own hardware, working alongside them to push the boundaries of AI in engineering, manufacturing, operations, and more
Work hands-on with startup software and hardware teams through pair programming and architecture reviews that accelerate their development, and understand their engineering workflows end to end, from design and simulation through test, production, and operations, so that your guidance fits how real hardware gets built
Develop prototypes and technical documentation, including evaluation suites, benchmarks grounded in real engineering tasks, AI engineering techniques, and architecture diagrams, that enable startups to build, operate, and scale with Claude
Create reference implementations and sample code that many companies can adopt without starting from scratch, for example integrating Claude with CAD, simulation, design tools, or industrial automation
Collaborate closely with Applied AI Architects to maintain context and continuity across customer engagements
Identify patterns across engagements, including what is hard about applying AI to physical systems such as reading drawings, 3D geometry, board layout and routing, GD&T, latency and on-premise constraints, and physical safety, then build repeatable evaluations and solutions and contribute insights back to Product, Engineering, Research, and the broader Applied AI team
Create technical content for startup audiences including documentation, tutorials, and sample code
Foster community engagement through hackathons, webinars, technical office hours, and startup-focused events
Travel to customer sites for workshops, implementation guidance, and relationship building

You may be a good fit if you have

Deep engineering experience in a physical discipline such as mechanical, electrical, aerospace, robotics, semiconductor, manufacturing, or civil engineering, gained by designing, building, or operating real hardware, along with strong opinions of your own about how to bridge the gap between what AI can do today and how physical things get built
4+ years of technical experience as a software engineer, ML or research engineer, robotics or controls engineer, hardware or systems engineer, or technical founder, with either production experience building LLM-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale, or a track record of successfully applying AI to real engineering work in design, simulation, test, or production
Experience with startups or high-growth companies and a love of working with founders and small teams that move quickly
Strong technical communication skills, with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into architectural decisions and actionable implementation plans for both software and hardware engineering audiences and to run technical workshops, hackathons, or developer-focused events
A collaborative approach to working across teams, the range of a generalist who can context-switch from robots to chips to rockets to factories and get up to speed on a new domain quickly, and a passion for making powerful technology safe and beneficial

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$280,000—$320,000 USD

Logistics

A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California:
We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
