added.title: Solution Architect
added.description:
Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?

Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real-world evidence to deliver real-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time.

With the advent of genomic sequencing, digital imaging, and techniques for large-scale clinical data processing, we have powerful new weapons in the data-driven fight against cancer. We're on a mission to connect an entire ecosystem to redefine how genomic and clinical data is used for evidence-based medicine.

On the Lens team at Tempus, we are building a data science platform to make it easier for researchers both inside and outside of Tempus to answer important questions in precision medicine using Tempus’ multi-modal clinical, imaging, and molecular data. Lens integrates our real-world data and advanced algorithms into a cloud-based Software-as-a-Service platform, transforming hypothesis generation and testing into a closed-loop process a single researcher can do in minutes, not an open-ended process a research team works on for months or years.

We are seeking a highly motivated and capable Solution Architect
with extensive experience and interest in oncology, real-world data, or genomics. Top candidates will also have experience working with cloud computing technologies, working with academic and foundation prospects and customers in pre- and post-sales engagements, as well as implementing machine learning and/or statistical models.

What You’ll Do

As a solution architect on the Lens team at Tempus, you’ll be on the front lines as we build and launch collaborations with academic and foundation partners in which we provide them with direct access to Tempus’ data and tools for the first time. You will be at the forefront of our implementation strategy for a brand-new customer enablement strategy, helping drive adoption and scalability. You will be helping guide customers through using the Lens platform to apply cutting-edge data science techniques to unique cancer datasets. You will be engaged with customers throughout their time working with Lens, including training and onboarding, filtering for data of interest, and the design and implementation of customer data science and analytics use cases. You will also work closely with the Data Science, Operations, and Medical Science teams to get datasets into customers’ hands.

Our solution architects should be comfortable on a whiteboard designing a potential retrospective study with primary investigators and their teams or in a boardroom with executives from major academic and regional health systems, providing trusted technical advice for our partners and clients. Additionally you will be embedded within our Real World Data and Translational Research teams, helping make sure customers are using the latest-and-greatest standards and practices for using Tempus data and tooling.

Requirements

Advanced degree (Masters or PhD) in bioinformatics, computational biology, statistics, computer science, or related field, or 3+ years experience working with genomic and clinical data
Experience working with statistical modeling, data mining and/or machine learning methods
Proficiency in R, python and/or other programming languages.
Experience with software development and the AWS or GCP technical stack
Experience with engineering practices for research computing (Docker, Git, Github, code review, Linux, cloud computing, etc)
Strong project management and post-sales skills: understanding and qualifying customer requirements, supporting customers in making progress against a roadmap, aligning scientific results with business outcomes
Demonstrated ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Nice-to-have

Familiarity with standard bioinformatics pipelines
Familiarity with the academic research landscape in oncology
Experience putting data science workflows into production
External outreach or education (consulting, giving talks, teaching, open source contributions)
Experience with SQL or other query languages

added.title: Software Engineer, ML Infrastructure
added.description:
About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.
Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.
Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:
Virtual Cell Initiative
:
Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets,  accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.
Alzheimer's Disease Initiative
:
Mapping the genes, pathways, and environmental factors behind Alzheimer's disease to develop drug candidates that address root causes.

More than 300 Arconauts work together at our Palo Alto headquarters, backed by substantial long-term philanthropic funding.
About the position

You'll join Arc's Infrastructure Engineering team and own the data and evaluation of ML infrastructure for Arc's virtual cell models. You'll start with two systems: our Model Performance Dashboard, which benchmarks those models, and the pipeline that turns single-cell data into their training sets. You'll set the technical direction for both and connect them, so every new dataset version is judged by what it does to the models. Later in your first year, the role widens into the engineering that makes the ML team's training and evaluation run fast and at scale, lab-in-the-loop infrastructure, validation frameworks for agent-written software, and Arc's rules for what research data we bring in, keep and share. The role consolidates ownership that is split across several teams today. 
Why this position could be the best job you’ve ever had

You will contribute to building a virtual cell. Your evals show which data makes Arc's models better, and the answer shapes which experiments Arc's labs run next.
You will own the platform end to end, and you work directly with the ML researchers and scientists who rely on it.

About you

You finish what you own, and you fix what's broken without being asked.
You're curious about the biology, enough to learn single-cell perturbation data and argue about what an eval should measure. 
You're steady when priorities shift. Research is high-risk, so you test ideas early and change course when the evidence says to.
You don't wait on scarce expert time. If proving a dataset's value means running the model evals yourself, you run them.

In this position you will

Own how Arc measures the performance of its virtual cell models, starting with the backend of our Model Performance Dashboard, which you'll take over within your first two months. 
Decide with the ML team which evaluation tools they need, then design and build them so researchers can evaluate and compare models themselves, and measure what each dataset version does to model performance.
Redesign the pipeline that turns single-cell data into training sets for our virtual cell models, then run it with AI agents: agents find, process and curate datasets, and automated quality checks, not manual review, decide whether a dataset version is ready for model training.
Own the lab-in-the-loop infrastructure that turns model performance results into the case for what Arc's labs should test next, working directly with the science leads who design those experiments .
Build or buy validation frameworks (tests, evals, QC gates, policies) that let agent-written code and apps ship without line-by-line human review. Start with our team, where you'll also own how we work with coding agents, then extend them to apps that scientists across Arc build themselves.
Own the engineering that makes the ML team's training and evaluation run fast, reliably and at scale. The ML team owns the research and the models. Once a model is ready to push, it enters the train-and-eval CI system you own, which feeds our Model Performance Dashboard. You'll also make multi-node training a supported path, track down distributed-training failures, and measure and raise throughput and GPU utilization (MFU) on clusters that Arc IT operates.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree with 8 years of relevant experience, or Master’s degree with 6 years of relevant experience.
You've owned a production data or ML platform that researchers depend on, end to end (pipelines, storage, versioning), and set its technical direction.
You design and build systems with AI tools and agents, and you make their output verifiable with evals, QC gates or tests before anyone relies on it.
You've learned an unfamiliar technical domain well enough to make design calls in it.
You work directly with stakeholders to find requirements, with no PM in between.
You make the people around you better through code review, pairing and writing patterns down.
You've diagnosed and fixed performance problems in Python or PyTorch systems with profilers and measurements: GPU utilization, memory, data loading.
Work onsite in our Palo Alto office at least 3 days a week.

Preferred Qualifications

You've worked with single-cell or perturbation data (AnnData/h5ad).
You've built or run model evaluations: benchmarks, eval harnesses, PyTorch/GPU inference.
You've run multi-node distributed training (DDP/FSDP, NCCL, SLURM) or raised a training job's throughput. This is a plus, not a requirement: we care more that you learn it fast with agents and show the numbers moved.
You've led an effort with one or two other engineers.

The base salary range for this position is $ 191,000 to $237,000 . These amounts reflect the range of base salary that the Institute reasonably would expect to pay a new hire or internal candidate for this position. The actual base compensation paid to any individual for this position may vary depending on factors such as experience, market conditions, education/training, skill level, and whether the compensation is internally equitable, and does not include bonuses, commissions, differential pay, other forms of compensation, or benefits. This position is also eligible to receive an annual discretionary bonus, with the amount dependent on individual and institute performance factors.
In addition to the Base Salary and Annual Bonus above, you will be eligible to participate in the Institute’s Compound Cash Grant Program (the “CCGP”). The CCGP is a program designed to offer multi-year cash grants providing for a fixed dollar amount paid out in semi-annual installments to reward employees for staying and contributing to the Institute. As soon as reasonably practical after your start date, you will receive a grant letter describing the terms of your award under the CCGP.

Job Description

Applicants must be a resident and work from one of the following states: WA, OR, ID, FL, IL, MN, NC, OH, TX, or SC with occasional travel to our headquarters, located in Seattle, WA.

Who We Are

At PEMCO, we’re all about people – our customers, our employees, and the community. We’re a mutual insurance company owned by our Northwest policyholders. We provide auto, home, renters, and boat coverage. Recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Insurance Companies in both Auto and Home for 2026, based on customer survey feedback, and by Newsweek as one of America’s Greatest Midsize Workplaces 2025. Our social impact programs motivate high achievement by youth in education; build stronger and greener communities; and increase safety at home, on the road, and at play. We’re committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging, and to fostering an inspiring and inclusive workplace. These efforts create and cultivate an environment that builds fairness and understanding, encourages collaboration and flexibility, and celebrates all the ways in which we’re different and the same – enabling all individuals to achieve their full potential.

Why We Need You

The Principal AI Platform Engineer role will build and run PEMCO's AI platform: the operational, economic, and governance layer under every AI agent and model the company uses. You own the stack end to end, from GPU compute through model serving, retrieval, and orchestration up to observability and governance, and you are expected to be capable of building and operating it on-premise when the economics justify it, not only consuming managed cloud services. This is a hands-on principal role with organizational influence: you build the systems yourself while setting the standards others build against.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own AI economics and observability. Build the consumption telemetry for the entire AI estate (cost per agent, per workflow, per business outcome; token usage; GPU utilization) and the LLM observability layer under it (LangFuse-class tracing, evaluation, drift monitoring). Leadership decisions about AI spend run on your data.
Run the AI gateway. A single gateway fronting every provider and model (LiteLLM-class or Azure APIM GenAI): routing, fallback chains, quotas, and per-agent cost capture. This is the enforcement point for the economics.
Stand up open-weight serving. High-throughput serving of open-weight models on Azure GPU capacity (vLLM, Triton/TensorRT-LLM), quantization, right-sizing. You build the sizing evidence that justifies or kills any future on-prem investment.
Build the retrieval layer. Vector stores, embedding pipelines, and document processing for in-house AI builds, on a governed platform rather than one-off deployments.
Operate production agents. Deployment, monitoring, incident response, and retirement for the agent fleet (MCP-based orchestration, per-agent least-privilege identity). When an agent supporting a business workflow fails, you own recovery.
Shape the architecture. Represent platform reliability, security, and economics in AI solution reviews across teams; constructively challenge designs with data and propose alternatives.
Hold the governance line. RBAC for models and agents, prompt/output guardrails, a seat on the AI Governance Working Group with authority to block deployments that do not meet the bar.
Compute and acceleration stack: Azure GPU VMs and AKS GPU pools first; on-premise GPU build-out (hardware selection, CUDA stack, Kubernetes GPU scheduling) when the sizing data says so
Models and serving stack: open-weight model families with high-throughput serving (vLLM, NVIDIA Triton/TensorRT-LLM), quantization, fine-tuning and LoRA adaptation; managed frontier APIs (Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry) as the other half of the portfolio
Gateway and routing stack: a single AI gateway fronting every provider and model; routing and fallback chains, quotas, per-agent cost capture
Retrieval and data stack: vector stores, embedding and chunking pipelines, document processing, knowledge-source governance
Orchestration and agents stack: agent frameworks and protocols (MCP, LangChain/LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), tool registration, per-agent least-privilege identity
Observability, evaluation, governance stack: LangFuse-class tracing and cost telemetry, evaluation tooling with regression testing before prompt or model changes ship, guardrails, RBAC
Across all layers: model lifecycle from evaluation to retirement, and cost-against-capability optimization (model selection and routing, caching, batching, token budgets).

What You'll Bring

6+ years in platform engineering, SRE, or technical operations at senior/lead scope
2+ years running LLM/AI systems in production (or 4+ years ML platform operations)
Hands-on open-weight model serving (vLLM, Triton/TensorRT-LLM or equivalent), including quantization and GPU right-sizing
LLM observability and evaluation experience (LangFuse, LangSmith, Arize class), or the demonstrated ability to stand it up
Experience building RAG systems: vector stores, embedding pipelines, document processing
FinOps/cost management for cloud consumption, ideally GPU or AI workloads
Working knowledge of AI security risks: prompt injection, data leakage, model abuse
Preferred: on-prem GPU infrastructure design, fine-tuning/LoRA, agent frameworks (MCP, LangChain/LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), regulated-industry experience

A leading global multi-strategy hedge fund is seeking a Machine Learning Research Scientist to join a newly formed systematic equities investment team based in New York. This is a front-office research role focused on the development of proprietary deep learning models for financial time-series data, supporting predictive signal generation and systematic investment strategies.

This position offers the opportunity to shape a long-term research agenda, design bespoke Transformer architectures from first principles and access significant computational resources for large-scale experimentation. The successful candidate will work closely with investment and technology professionals to translate advanced machine learning research into actionable trading signals, operating within a collaborative environment where scientific rigour and independent thinking are highly valued.

Key Responsibilities

Design and implement custom decoder-only Transformer architectures for financial time-series modelling.
Develop tokenisation approaches for intraday market data, incorporating price movements, volume, order flow and cross-sectional features.
Build efficient PyTorch training pipelines using mixed-precision training, gradient checkpointing and multi-GPU parallelism.
Research attention mechanisms that capture temporal relationships, cross-asset dependencies and patterns across multiple timescales.
Develop evaluation frameworks to assess predictive accuracy, signal quality and trading performance.
Optimise model inference for low-latency production deployment through compression, quantisation and efficient decoding techniques.
Conduct rigorous experiments and ablation studies to validate architectural choices and training methodologies.
Collaborate with researchers and developers to integrate model predictions into live trading infrastructure.
Define and execute a sustained research agenda, assessing new approaches and refining models through systematic experimentation.
Document research methodology, experimental findings and architectural decisions.

Requirements

PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics or a related discipline, with a focus on deep learning.
Demonstrated experience implementing Transformer architectures from first principles.
Deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional encodings, tokenisation strategies and model training dynamics.
Expert-level PyTorch skills, including custom modules, training loops, mixed-precision training and multi-GPU training.
Experience training large-scale models with 100 million or more parameters.
Strong mathematical foundations in linear algebra, probability, optimisation and information theory.
Strong programming skills in Python and C++ for performance-critical components.
Ability to independently define and execute a research agenda spanning several months.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools.
Experience applying deep learning to financial data or time-series forecasting, including tokenisation of continuous or non-text data, is advantageous.

Knowledge of market microstructure, intraday trading dynamics, model compression and inference optimisation is beneficial.

added.title: Staff+ Research Scientist, Multi-Agent
added.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Multi-Agent systems are becoming an increasingly important part of how AI is deployed, whether via fast small-model subagents inside a product, or large groups of agents solving very large problems. Training Claude to be maximally effective and safe within large groups is a challenging new area of reinforcement learning, and represents a new axis for scaling test time compute.

We are looking for researchers who have experience training multi-agent systems at the largest scale and an appreciation for the incentives and mechanism design that come into play.

Responsibilities

Help create and optimize environments and data for model training that maximize Claude’s performance or ease of use on agentic tasks
Ideate, develop, and compare the performance of different agent harness configurations (eg memory, context management, communication architectures for agents)
Design and implement rigorous quantitative benchmarks for large scale agentic tasks
Work with our product org to find solutions to our most vexing challenges in applying agents to our products

You May Be a Good Fit If You

Have experience with large-scale RL on language models
Have experience training multi-agent systems
Enjoy going deeply into the roots of a problem and understanding its foundations, rather than its surface.
Have good communication skills and an interest in working with other researchers on difficult tasks
Have a passion for making powerful technology safe and societally beneficial
Are excited for a mission-driven org with fast-paced, impactful work

Representative Projects

Design and build reinforcement learning environments to train groups of Claudes how to solve problems together efficiently
Design and build agent affordances that unlock new capabilities and scales of agents, while keeping the Bitter Lesson in mind
Design and build a novel eval that measures how large teams of agents interact in groups to solve problems

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$500,000—$850,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California:
We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting . We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Your Impact on our Mission

Zocdoc's mission is simple and hard: give power to the patient. We are the nation's leading digital healthcare marketplace — connecting millions of patients to the right care, faster than ever.

The Data & Analytics team is at the center of how Zocdoc grows, evolves, and makes high-stakes decisions at scale. As a Sr/Staff Data Scientist you will be one of the most senior analytical voices at the company — a strategic thought partner to directors and senior leadership across Product, Marketing, Sales, Finance, Revenue, Operations, Customer Experience, and Platform.

You'll work on some of Zocdoc's most complex and ambiguous business problems — where the question itself isn't always defined, and the right method doesn't fit neatly into a playbook. You'll lead the analytical strategy, apply rigorous experimentation and causal inference frameworks at scale, and turn structured thinking into decisions that shape how Zocdoc grows.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact individual contributor role. Success here is measured not just by the quality of your analyses, but by the clarity, influence, and scalability of the thinking you bring to the teams around you.

You'll enjoy this role if you are…

Energized by working at the intersection of product strategy, growth, monetization, and experimentation and genuinely excited to go deep on all of it
The kind of person who frames the problem before jumping to the analysis and understands that question-setting is half the work
Comfortable operating with ambiguity and decisive under uncertainty you know how to move fast without sacrificing rigor
A force multiplier — you get real satisfaction from enabling other teams to make better decisions, not just from what you personally build
Passionate about connecting technical work to real business outcomes — you know that a great model no one acts on is a missed opportunity
Serious about your work, but not about yourself — you understand that great outcomes come from trust, collaboration, and a healthy sense of perspective

Your day to day is…

Leading experimentation and analytical strategy across product, growth, monetization, marketing, and operational initiatives, often simultaneously
Applying causal inference methodologies (difference-in-differences, synthetic controls, propensity methods, Bayesian experimentation) to real business questions where traditional A/B testing may not be feasible
Partnering directly with directors and senior leaders to frame complex, cross-functional challenges and translate findings into clear recommendations that drive action
Improving experimentation frameworks, metrics strategy, and analytical rigor across teams — developing scalable approaches for measurement, segmentation, forecasting, and incrementality
Influencing roadmap prioritization and business strategy through rigorous analysis and precise communication of tradeoffs and uncertainty
Mentoring and upskilling data scientists and analysts across the organization on experimentation, causal inference, and statistical best practices
Partnering with Engineering, Product, and ML teams on instrumentation, data infrastructure, and analytics tooling
Integrating generative AI tools into daily workflows to automate tasks, foster innovation, and maximize analytical productivity

You'll be successful in this role if you have…

An unrelenting desire to build more equitable, inclusive, and diverse workplaces — you view this role as an opportunity to create positive change
8+ years of experience in Data Science, Product Analytics, Applied Analytics, or Experimentation, with a track record of solving high-impact, cross-functional business problems. A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Economics, Physics, or a related field; a Master's degree or PhD in a quantitative field is a plus
Experience partnering with senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing, Revenue, Sales, Operations, or Customer Experience organizations to drive strategy through data
Strong experimentation experience at scale, including causal inference methodologies applied to real-world, often messy business settings
Advanced SQL proficiency and strong Python fluency, with the ability to work across large, complex datasets
The ability to integrate generative AI tools into daily workflows to automate tasks, foster innovation, and maximize productivity
Familiarity with areas such as: pricing and monetization analytics, growth and retention strategy, customer segmentation and lifecycle, marketing attribution and incrementality, or operational and marketplace analytics
Experience in fast-paced, high-growth environments — consumer technology, SaaS, fintech, marketplace, or platform companies is highly relevant
Humility — you believe in treating all people with dignity and respect, regardless of title or tenure

Axle
is a bioscience and information technology company that offers advancements in translational research, biomedical informatics, and data science applications to research centers and healthcare organizations nationally and abroad. With experts in biomedical science, software engineering, and program management, we focus on developing and applying research tools and techniques to empower decision-making and accelerate research discoveries. Axle
is seeking a Bioinformatics/Data Scientist
to join our vibrant team at the National Institutes of Health (NIH) supporting the Standardized Organoid Model Center in Frederick, MD.
The Standardized Organoid Model Center is an NIH-funded initiative dedicated to advancing organoid research through the development of validated, reproducible, and well-characterized organoid models. The center brings together interdisciplinary teams of researchers to establish standardized protocols, develop quality control measures, and create resources that will benefit the broader organoid research community.

What experience do you have working with large datasets and compute clusters?
Describe your experience building workflows/pipelines and/or using bioinformatics software and tools to analyze data.

Overview

The Bioinformatics/Data Scientist will conduct comprehensive analyses of multi-omics data generated from organoid systems and corresponding normal tissues. This position is central to the SOM Center's research objectives, focusing on characterizing organoid fidelity, identifying biomarkers of successful differentiation, and developing computational frameworks for organoid quality assessment.

Responsibilities

The successful candidate will analyze complex datasets including single-cell RNA sequencing, bulk RNA sequencing, proteomics, and metabolomics data from various organoid systems and their tissue counterparts.
The position will develop and implement computational pipelines for data processing, quality control, and statistical analysis.
A major component of the role involves integrating SOM-generated data with publicly available datasets to benchmark organoid characteristics against normal tissue profiles.

Required Qualifications

Candidates must hold a PhD in bioinformatics, computational biology, biostatistics, or a related quantitative field.
Extensive experience with single-cell data analysis, including familiarity with tools such as Seurat, Scanpy, or similar platforms, is essential.
Strong programming skills in R and Python are required, along with experience in statistical analysis and data visualization.
Knowledge of proteomics and metabolomics data analysis workflows is necessary.

Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience analyzing organoid datasets is strongly preferred.
Experience with machine learning approaches for biological data, familiarity with pathway analysis tools, and knowledge of developmental biology principles will be considered valuable assets.
Experience with high-performance computing environments and version control systems is desirable.

Tenure-Track Assistant or Associate Professor in
Water Data Science

The Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering at Northwestern University invites applications for a full-time, tenure-track faculty position in the broad area of artificial intelligence and data science for water. The successful candidate is expected to build and sustain a world-class research program in intelligent, adaptive, and autonomous water technologies for water-resilient communities, integrating artificial intelligence and machine learning into the design, optimization, and security of next-generation water systems. Candidates working on all aspects of this problem are welcome to apply, including AI-enabled water treatment technologies, optimization of water treatment processes and systems, water resources data analysis and planning, water reuse and resource recovery, and links between water quality and public health. Research approaches can include theoretical, computational, and experimental methods. Applicants must hold a Ph.D. or be near completion of their doctoral studies with demonstrated potential to develop an advanced research and education program. The faculty appointment could be made at the level of either assistant professor or associate professor.

Northwestern University is a leading R1 university with a number of highly ranked schools and departments that provide exceptional opportunities for collaboration across a wide range of disciplines. The Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering is ranked 13 th in the US, and the McCormick School of Engineering and Applied Science is ranked 16 th . The successful candidate is expected to develop collaborations leveraging Northwestern’s robust research centers and institutes, including the Northwestern Center for Water , Center for Engineering Sustainability & Resilience , Trienens Institute for Sustainability and Energy , Northwestern Institute on Complex Systems , and substantial new investments in the Northwestern Network for Collaborative Intelligence and the Thriving Planet Institute . Northwestern is located in Evanston, Illinois, on the shore of Lake Michigan, just outside the city of Chicago, providing excellent opportunities to engage in water research with high-tech industry and a variety of governmental agencies. Northwestern is a founding member of a regional water hub Current Innovation and the NSF Great Lakes ReNEW Water Innovation Engine , providing a network of collaborators and ongoing funding to support water research.

Job Description Summary

You will work within an interdisciplinary team to innovate and push the technical envelope in all aspects of magnetic resonance imaging. You will have opportunities to work both on MRI systems hardware as well as algorithms and pulse sequence development. The research and development work will be across 1.5T-3.0T whole body and 3.0T-7.0T high-performance, head-only MRI platforms.

Job Description

As a Magnetic Resonance Research Scientist, you will:

Apply deep knowledge in MR physics, mathematics, engineering and chemistry to conceptualize and prototype novel MR systems and applications that address key clinical needs.
Develop impactful applications that leverage next-generation MRI sub-systems that have enhanced imaging capabilities. Examples are in high-performance gradient coils, RF coils, receiver sub-systems, gradient drivers, etc.
Develop and deploy investigational MR applications and systems in clinical and preclinical environments for tests and validation.
Determine the impact of systems hardware performance on image quality and safety.
Develop algorithmic and/ or systems hardware solutions for MR-guided therapy and interventional applications.
Grow external collaborations with academic and industry partners through joint publications, grant submissions and advanced technology development.
Work with clinicians to refine emerging technologies for clinical applications.
Create intellectual property by generating invention disclosures and filing patents.
Maintain external visibility through conference presentations and peer-reviewed journal publications.

Required Qualifications

Ph.D. degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Chemistry, Computer Engineering, or other related fields, with at least 3 years of research experience.
A demonstrated record of research and development outcomes as evidenced by peer-reviewed conference proceedings and journal publications.
Strong fundamentals in MR imaging physics and sub-systems, signal processing and electromagnetic theory.
Demonstrated strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to understand and address root causes of MR image quality issues in investigational prototypes.
Proficiency in programming in C, Python and/ or simulation tools.
Must be willing to work out of an office located in Niskayuna, NY.

Desired Characteristics

Demonstrated ability to originate and follow through on ideas.
High levels of curiosity, independence and adaptability.
Strong interpersonal skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Experience in writing and executing grant proposals.
Experience in developing or modifying components of MR sub-systems leading to measurable changes in image quality and new applications.
Experience in EM and multi-physics modeling, especially for analysis of RF transmit and gradient field bioeffects.
Experience in pulse sequence programming on a GE HealthCare MRI scanner and/ or developing new image reconstruction algorithms.

added.title: Data Scientist, Product
added.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

As part of our growing Data Science and Analytics team, you will play an instrumental role in our company’s mission of building safe and beneficial artificial intelligence by driving data-informed decision making across our organization. You’ve worked in cultures of excellence in the past, and are eager to apply that experience to help shape the cultural norms and best practices of a growing data science team as Anthropic continues to scale. In this unique company, technology, and moment in history, your work will be critical to informing our strategy as we deploy safe, frontier AI at scale to the world.

Responsibilities

Deep dive into product and user data to derive actionable insights and size opportunities to improve products, strategy and operations, influencing roadmaps through your insights and recommendations
Develop hypotheses, apply rigorous causal inference methods – controlled experiments, synthetic controls – and analyze the results in order make actionable recommendations
Investigate anomalies, conduct root cause analyses, and provide data-driven insights to guide priorities and inform decisions
Define core metrics, build measurement frameworks, and maintain core reporting to evaluate success
Build statistical models, optimization frameworks, and simulations to automate decision-making and operational processes
Present complex technical analyses and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Establish foundational data practices and help scale our analytics infrastructure to support rapid iteration and decision-making as our products grow

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

7+ years of experience in data science or analytics roles
Deep expertise with Python, SQL, and data visualization tools
Expertise with experimental design, causal inference, statistical modeling, and A/B testing frameworks, particularly in high-scale technical environments
Highly effective written communication and presentation skills
A track record of translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and business stakeholders
A bias for action and ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you must create clarity and drive forward progress
A passion for the company’s mission of building helpful, honest, and harmless AI
Some experience with AI/ML products, large language models, or developer tools in the AI/ML ecosystem

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$285,000—$380,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California:
We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Senior Exploitation Specialist / Data Scientist:

At Accora, we foster and embrace a distinct set of values that we live by and instill in all aspects of our organization: dedication, commitment, partnership, trust, and recognition. We have incorporated these values into successful delivery for our customers since 1988. Accora believes in ensuring its employees feel deeply connected to Accora, recognizing successes and hard work, and providing continuous opportunities to learn and grow. Our people are entrepreneurial thinkers who combine mindset, vision, and experience to drive value – not only for us as an organization, but also for the clients we support. We promote a collaborative culture with our clients, and with each other, as one team working towards a common vision. We’d love you to join our team

Job Summary

Accora Federal is looking for a Senior Exploitation Specialist / Data Scientist
to join a contract with a federal government client in support of an important mission. We are seeking a Senior Exploitation Specialist (Data Scientist) to support NGA mission operations at an Analysis Office, NGA St. Louis (N2W) in Saint Louis, MO. As an Exploitation Specialist under the GEO-SPI B labor framework, the successful candidate transforms large and complex geospatial and intelligence data into mission-ready analytic products, automated workflows, and decision-advantage tools.

This is a Senior-level (Level 4) position. The individual is expected to lead, integrate, define tasks, and validate work, demonstrating advanced knowledge and skills that have been proven in previous work. A Senior is fully capable of meeting all required services without direction, provides technical direction and quality control over lower-level personnel, advises Government leadership on processes and technology, and leads collaboration across NGA and Intelligence Community (IC) analysts to deliver synthesized analysis that is greater than the sum of its parts.

Responsibilities

Design and implement scalable, repeatable processes for large and complex datasets to identify trends, insights, and analytic discoveries.
Script at a senior level in Python to build mission-ready solutions (experience with other languages and low-code/no-code tools such as JEMA, Brewlytics, or ArcGIS Model Builder is a plus, but Python is required).
Translate analytic discoveries into visualizations that are easily integrated into daily operations.
Provide analysis and/or data science directly supporting the intelligence mission.
Operate in a high-tempo environment, developing and managing multiple projects and solutions simultaneously across various stages of implementation.
Provide senior-level direction, quality control, and quality assurance over lower-level personnel, and lead collaboration across NGA and IC analysts to deliver synthesized analysis.

Education And Experience

Experience: 10+ years of relevant experience.
Education: Bachelor's degree in a related field.

Required Skills

A background with intelligence experience, having provided analysis and/or data science directly supporting an intelligence mission.
Ability to operate at a senior level and in an independent environment.
Proficiency in creating processes around large data sets to identify analytical discoveries.
Demonstrated proficiency designing and implementing scalable processes for large and complex datasets to identify trends, insights, and analytical discoveries.
Ability to script at a senior level in Python (other languages and low-code/no-code programs such as JEMA, Brewlytics, or ArcGIS Model Builder are valuable, but Python is required).
Ability to take analytic discoveries and deliver them through visualizations that are easily integrated into daily operations.
Ability to operate in a high-tempo environment and develop and manage multiple projects and solutions at one time in various stages of implementation.
Familiarity with common Intelligence Community (IC) data repositories.

Desired Skills

Coding / computer programming, data management, and data service enabling.
Data analytics, data conditioning, and data visualization.
Geomatics and remote sensing expertise.
Software expertise and integration across enterprise systems.
Written communication and intelligence report writing.
Quality assurance and mission issue expertise relevant to the supported office.

Security Clearance

Active TS Clearance.

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of this position, with or without accommodation.

Ability to remain stationary for extended periods while working at a computer.
Frequently operate standard office equipment, including computers and telephones.
Ability to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, video conference, and email.
Occasionally move about the office and lift up to 20 pounds.
Ability to work the assigned schedule with regular and reliable attendance.

added.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a part of the Strategic Analytics and Modeling team within the Transformation Command Center working on Network Capital Strategy, you will lead projects to develop and perform complex AI-first and agentic modeling including statistical, analytical or advanced analytics on challenging long-term network capacity questions, aiming to "right-size" the future capacity planning needs for the multi-billion dollar investments in our Verizon Network.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll have high autonomy to create, improve, design and execute using AI for capacity simulations and optimization, in partnership with the relevant business partners, while on the lookout for new modeling techniques, evolving technologies and emerging industry trends that can improve accuracy, speed or generally quality of simulations. Your work will help ensure that the needs of the network that serves our customer has accurate capacity plans so downstream finance teams may appropriately fund budgetary requests for next-year expansion or operational network efforts.

Responsibilities Include

Working with stakeholders to develop AI, agent-based modeling, and algorithmic modeling for network elements and processes to support the 3-year capital budget.
Planning and executing the design of the new capacity model, obtaining general agreement from NCS and the business team.
Operating the model across multiple checkpoints in a year, creating a hardened deployment, documentation, and plans for future automation of the process.
Planning future upgrades to the model with alternate types of algorithms, AI science or additional input features.
Actively leveraging and piloting AI tools — including agentic workflows, LLM-assisted coding, and automated documentation/reporting — to accelerate model development, scenario testing, and stakeholder deliverables; Verizon expressly supports and encourages AI-augmented approaches to this work.
Assertively adapt and navigate roadblocks in the software development process, self-resolving issues and escalating roadblocks when appropriate.
Conducting occasional presentations to leaders and engineers to describe the nature of created systems.
Protecting invented Verizon Intellectual Property by pursuing patents when appropriate.

What We're Looking For

A passion for creativity, AI, innovation, process improvement, advanced algorithms, and best-practices of independent software design. A motivated, independent individual who can properly discern next-steps in the absence of requirements, and determine when to appropriately collaborate with the team and business partners. Proven ability to communicate technical information to technical or non-technical audiences with an understanding that each project has the ability to change millions of dollars of spend to benefit the customer's network experience.

You'll Need To Have

Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience.
Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Intermediate proficiency in Python (or R), SQL with a moderate history or portfolio of accomplished projects.
Intermediate proficiency in Alteryx or Knime.
Experience building or integrating agentic AI workflows (e.g., LLM-based agents, tool-use/function-calling pipelines, or automation frameworks like LangChain, AutoGen, or Claude/GPT-based agents) to automate data ingestion, scenario generation, or report synthesis in support of capital planning and simulation workflows.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

Degree in business intelligence and analytics, data science, engineering, computer science, mathematics or similar.
Experience in time series analysis / forecasting.
Strong experience in engineering investigations, performance optimizations, or network capacity management.
Prior experience navigating engineering budget cycles, such as funding requests for cell-site builds in a regional role.
Proven experience with gathering requirements and translating requirements to specific software practices.
Experience with data engineering.
Knowledge of cloud computing platforms e.g. Google Cloud Platform or Amazon Web Services.
Experience with high performance containerized GPU environments.
Solid foundation in mathematical optimization, prescriptive modeling, and network capacity management.
Designing, architecting, and deploying full-stack web applications and APIs—leveraging frameworks like FastAPI, custom GUIs (e.g., Flet, Marimo), and high-performance BI dashboards—to expose optimization models, streamline data ingestion, and accelerate scenario planning for non-technical leadership.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

added.title: Data Scientist
added.description:
About The Role

The Data Scientist is a technical analytics role supporting Finance, Operations, Marketing, and Development with data and business analysis. The majority of the role is hands-on coding and analysis: writing SQL against a Snowflake data warehouse, building Python-based analytical models, and developing BI dashboards. The role covers the full spectrum from descriptive analytics (what happened) to predictive modeling (what will happen) to prescriptive analysis (what should we do about it).

A Day in the Life

Write SQL and Python to build, test, and maintain analytical datasets and pipelines in Snowflake.
Build descriptive analytics: dashboards, KPI frameworks, and ad hoc queries that answer "what happened and why."
Build predictive models: forecasting, segmentation, and other statistical/ML models that answer "what's likely to happen."
Build prescriptive analysis: scenario modeling and recommendations that answer "what should we do."
Partner with Finance, Ops, Marketing, and Development stakeholders to scope analytical questions and translate business problems into data solutions.
Design and maintain BI dashboards (Power BI, Omni) for self-serve reporting across teams.
Conduct exploratory data analysis to surface trends, anomalies, and root causes in business performance.
Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

What Sets You Apart

Strong hands-on coding ability in SQL and Python; comfortable building datasets and models from raw data, not just querying finished tables.
Working knowledge of statistical and machine learning methods (regression, classification, clustering, time series forecasting) and when to apply them.
Experience building and maintaining BI dashboards (Power BI, Looker, Tableau, or similar) for multiple business audiences.
Ability to translate ambiguous business questions from Finance, Ops, Marketing, or Development into a defined analytical approach.
Strong data modeling and data warehousing fundamentals (Snowflake, dbt, or similar).
Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to move from data exploration to a clear recommendation.
Ability to thrive independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while managing multiple priorities.
Strong communication skills, capable of explaining technical work to non-technical stakeholders.

Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in data science, statistics, computer science, or a related quantitative field.
3+ years of experience in data science, data analytics, or business analytics, including hands-on SQL/Python work and applied statistical or ML modeling.
Experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake or similar) and BI tools (Power BI or similar).
Experience supporting cross-functional business stakeholders (finance, operations, or marketing analytics) is a plus.

Benefits & Perks

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being, financial future, and professional growth.

Health & Wellness: Medical, Dental, Vision, HDHP with HSA, employer-paid Life Insurance, Disability, Mental Health & EAP benefits

Employee Perks: Weekly office breakfast, Fun Committee, DE&I Council, employee discounts, and time off to vote

Benefits are generally effective the first of the month following 30 days of employment and are subject to applicable plan terms.

Overview

CAREERS TO SMILE ABOUT

At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.

At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve.

Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you.

Responsibilities

Lead solution architecture for agentic AI solutions across Supply Chain programs such as DTV, Procurement, R2P, Warehousing, Manufacturing, Transportation, and Network Design, ensuring designs meet enterprise standards for security, scalability, reliability, and observability.

Solution Architecture & Design - (40%)

Produce end-to-end solution architecture artifacts (HLD/LLD, C4 context/container, sequence diagrams) for consumer/commercial agentic use cases and enabling services.
Define integration patterns with customer-facing platforms (CRM, commerce, marketing tech, customer data platforms), API ecosystems, and data platforms.

Governance & Architecture Review - (25%)

Review agentic solution designs for compliance with platform patterns, security guardrails, and enterprise architecture standards.
Document ADRs for key design choices, exceptions, and trade-offs; drive remediation actions for non-compliant designs.

Non‑Functional & Production Readiness - (20%)

Define and validate NFRs: availability, latency, throughput, resilience, auditability, security, privacy, and cost controls.
Ensure observability and operational readiness are designed-in (logging, tracing, metrics, evals, runbooks, rollback patterns).

Stakeholder Collaboration - (15%)

Partner with product owners, engineering teams, data teams, platform teams, and vendors to deliver aligned architecture and unblock dependencies.
Facilitate architecture workshops and design sign-offs across cross-functional teams

Decision-Making Autonomy - Moderate

Significant autonomy in the technical aspects of AI model development and implementation, working under the strategic direction provided by the Senior AI Solutions Manager.

Supervision Required - Moderate

Operates with general guidance from the Senior AI Solutions Manager, with regular updates for alignment and support.

Complexity of Role - High

The role requires managing complex AI/ML projects, working with large datasets, and ensuring successful integration with existing systems while maintaining scalability.

Cross-Functional Interactions

Regular interaction with Data Science, Engineering, IT, digital products and business stakeholders to ensure effective AI solution deployment.

Compensation and Benefits:

The expected compensation range for this position is between $110,700 - $185,250.
Location, confirmed job-related skills, experience, and education will be considered in setting actual starting salary. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process.
Bonus based on performance and eligibility target payout is 12% of annual salary paid out annually.
Paid time off subject to eligibility, including paid parental leave, vacation, sick, and bereavement.
In addition to salary, PepsiCo offers a comprehensive benefits package to support our employees and their families, subject to elections and eligibility: Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Health, and Dependent Care Reimbursement Accounts, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Insurance (Accident, Group Legal, Life), Defined Contribution Retirement Plan.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data/AI, or related field.
Experience: 9+ years in solution architecture with enterprise supply chain technology exposure.

Required Skills / Experience

Proven experience producing solution architectures for enterprise initiatives including HLD/LLD, integration diagrams, and NFR specifications.
Strong integration design experience across APIs, events, batch processing, and data platforms; ability to define contract-driven interfaces (schemas, error handling, versioning).
Practical understanding of agentic AI architecture patterns: tool/action execution, orchestration, memory/state, retrieval/grounding, evaluation/quality, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Experience designing for security and compliance: IAM concepts (RBAC), data classification/PII considerations, auditability, and explicit trust boundary enforcement.
Experience with production readiness: observability (logs/metrics/traces), resilience (timeouts/retries/idempotency), operational runbooks, and change control.
Strong supply chain domain understanding across at least 3-4 areas: planning, procurement, warehousing, manufacturing, transportation, network design.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C(.
Ability to drive adoption through clear documentation, reference implementations, and enablement of engineers and architects across teams.
Experience and working knowledge with Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., Langchain, CrewAi, MCP, A2A) and deployment of AI solutions on cloud infrastructures (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
Strong understanding and experience in designing AI agents and integrating advancements in AI/ML technologies.

Preferred Skills / Experience

Experience integrating with SAP and/or supply chain planning platforms (or equivalent systems of record).
Familiarity with AI platform components (LLM providers, vector DB/RAG, model routing, evaluation frameworks).
Experience working with agile delivery at scale (PI planning, cross-team dependency management).

Differentiating Competencies

Strong stakeholder influence and ability to drive alignment across product, engineering, data, and security teams.
Ability to simplify complex systems into clear architectures and guide teams toward reusable patterns.
Bias for measurable outcomes: reliability, adoption, cost, and operational stability.
Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of new technologies, GenAI algorithms and Agentic tools.
Problem-Solving: Ability to translate business challenges into technical solutions.
Collaboration Skills: Effective at working within cross-functional teams.
Agility: Flexibility to adapt to changing requirements and new technologies.
Communication Skills: Capable of explaining complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Technology is foundational to all of Appnovation’s offerings, from consulting to digital innovation to digital product and service creation. The technology department is focused on delivering software solutions that enable rich consumer experiences, from mobile and web applications to advanced analytics and machine learning, to content and engagement management service enablement platforms.

Inherent throughout our tech capabilities is deep expertise in the Software Development Life Cycle, a drive for creativity, a passion for the craft, and collaboration with other disciplines - all foundational ingredients in successful digital experiences and client partnerships.

We are seeking a Principal Solutions Architect to define the architecture for a governed, zero-copy, cross-cloud data platform, establishing the design standards and integration priorities that guide the engineering team. Working across Databricks, Snowflake, and adjacent cloud data sources, this leader will translate an evolving product vision into concrete design specifications and a clear path toward agent-based data consumption, while ensuring alignment with the organization’s existing enterprise engineering practices. The role is accountable for owning the end-to-end solution architecture of a governed, zero-copy data platform in which data remains in place within its source systems. This position requires a senior, hands-on technical leader who can operate at the intersection of platform strategy, modern data engineering, and architectural governance — creating clarity from complexity, making sound build-versus-integrate trade-offs, and setting the technical standards that help Appnovation’s clients deliver faster, safer, and more reusable data capabilities.

Role Responsibilities

Solution Architecture Ownership: Own the end-to-end solution architecture for a governed, zero-copy data platform in which data remains in place within its source systems, working across Databricks, Snowflake, and adjacent cloud data sources.
Architecture Artifacts and Standards: Produce architecture artifacts — decision records, reference architectures, and solution diagrams — establish the design standards that guide the engineering team, and provide clear build-versus-integrate recommendations.
Catalog and Metadata Integration: Define and prioritize catalog and metadata integration patterns across cloud and lakehouse environments.
Agent-Based Access Design: Design agent- and MCP-based access patterns that expose governed data products to enterprise AI tools and agent platforms.
Future-State Direction: Establish future-state direction for data products, cross-source data composition, and agentic consumption, translating an evolving product vision into concrete design specifications.
Enterprise Alignment: Ensure alignment with the organization’s existing enterprise engineering practices while guiding the engineering team toward a clear path for agent-based data consumption.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, with 10+ years of technology experience, including significant experience in solution, enterprise, or data architecture.
Senior solutions or enterprise architect with demonstrated experience designing cross-cloud and multi-cloud data architectures.
Proven application of zero-copy, data-mesh, and data-product principles, including domain-driven design.
Deep expertise in data governance, including attribute- and role-based access control, data sensitivity and policy classification, and geolocation-based access requirements.
Experience defining data-contract standards (e.g., the Linux Foundation / Open Data Contract Standard) and embedding governance metadata into platform workflows.
Strong background in identity and access management for both users and machine/agent identities (OAuth/OIDC, service accounts).
Excellent communication, stakeholder-management, and documentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Prior experience in a consulting or client-facing delivery environment, working across multiple concurrent initiatives and priorities.

Experience operating in a regulated life-sciences or comparable compliance-driven environment (GxP, GDPR/HIPAA, PII/PHI handling).

You can influence technology choices with both engineers and senior leaders

Job Description

Optimizely's Customer Success team partners with our largest and most complex customers to help them realize real ROI from the Optimizely platform — through strategic guidance, hands-on execution, and technical problem-solving. Within Customer Success, our SWAT team is the group customers and internal teams call when something is urgent, technically hard, or ambiguous: a critical blocker threatening a launch, a platform limitation with no obvious workaround, or a business problem nobody has solved before.

We're hiring a Principal Solutions Architect to join the SWAT team. This is a dual mandate: you'll parachute into high-stakes customer situations and resolve complex technical blockers quickly and credibly, and you'll build new solutions, particularly using AI and automation, that create lasting internal efficiency or open new value we can offer customers. You are as comfortable earning trust on a tense customer call as you are prototyping an agent or automation that eliminates a manual process for good.

Serve as a senior technical responder for escalated, high-complexity customer situations, diagnosing root causes across the Optimizely platform and driving fast, credible resolutions under pressure.
Act as a trusted technical voice directly with enterprise customers, translating deep technical detail into clear, confidence-building guidance for both technical and business stakeholders.
Identify recurring blockers, inefficiencies, or unmet needs across engagements, and design and build AI-driven or automated solutions that address them, whether that's an internal tool, an accelerator, or a repeatable delivery pattern.
Prototype and ship practical automations (scripts, integrations, AI agents/workflows) that reduce manual effort for the Customer Success team or unlock new offerings for customers.
Partner cross-functionally with Delivery, Product, Engineering, and Sales to scope solutions, validate feasibility, and hand off sustainable outcomes, not one-off fixes.
Document patterns and playbooks from SWAT engagements so solutions scale beyond the single engagement that produced them.
Mentor other consultants on complex troubleshooting approaches and emerging AI/automation techniques.

Qualifications

A track record of solving complex, ambiguous technical problems in customer-facing settings — you stay calm and credible when the pressure is on and the answer isn't obvious yet.
Strong consulting instincts: you build trust quickly with technical and executive stakeholders alike, and you communicate clearly under pressure.
Hands-on experience building AI-driven or automated solutions — e.g., scripting, API integrations, low-code/no-code tooling, or LLM-based agents/workflows — that you've taken from idea to something people use. Strong strategic fluency in applying AI/automation to business problems is a minimum bar; direct build experience is strongly preferred.
Experience with the Optimizely platform (CMS, Commerce, Experimentation, CDP, or related products) is preferred; equivalent depth with comparable enterprise SaaS/web platforms will also be considered.
Comfort operating with significant autonomy and ambiguity — SWAT work is inherently undefined until you define it.
Willingness to travel occasionally (under 10%) for key onsite escalations or workshops.

We care most about demonstrated skills and outcomes, not a specific years-of-experience threshold — candidates from varied backgrounds (solutions architecture, technical consulting, platform engineering, or similar) are encouraged to apply.

Additional Information

Why This Role

High visibility: SWAT engagements are seen by senior leadership on both the customer and Optimizely side.
Real latitude to build: this role is explicitly chartered to invent, not just execute — your automation and AI work can reshape how Customer Success delivers.
Variety: no two weeks look the same, spanning technical firefighting, solution design, and prototyping.
A team that partners with you: SWAT works closely with Delivery, Product, and Engineering rather than in isolation.
