Who We Are

Exiger is the AI partner for supply chain and procurement automation. Its centralized 1EXIGER.AI platform allows organizations to manage their entire operating network, from parts to suppliers, regulators, and customers, through an autonomous agentic workforce that learns, adapts, and augments with every decision.

The AI-native platform, combined with the largest supply chain knowledge asset, empowers 550+ global customers, including 150 Fortune 500 and 80+ government and defense industrial organizations, to act first. Exiger is FedRAMP® authorized and a 2x Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management.

Build the Next Generation of Super Intelligence Products

At Exiger, we're reimagining how AI-powered products are conceived, built, and delivered. Our vision for Super Intelligence brings together advanced AI, intelligent agents, proprietary data, and human expertise to help organizations solve complex problems and make better decisions.

We're looking for an experienced Senior
AI Product Builder
who thrives at the intersection of product, technology, and the customer.

This is not a traditional Product Manager role focused solely on roadmaps and requirements, nor is it a purely engineering role focused only on implementation. We're looking for someone who can understand complex business challenges, work directly with customers and stakeholders, identify what should be built, and help turn those ideas into working AI-powered products.

You should be equally comfortable leading a conversation with business executives, collaborating with engineers on technical approaches, and rapidly prototyping solutions using AI tools, APIs, code, and automation platforms.

The ideal candidate brings strong product instincts, hands-on technical experience, and the ability to navigate ambiguity. You've worked directly with customers, understand how to uncover their underlying needs, and know how to translate those insights into products that deliver measurable value.

You'll play an important role in shaping Exiger's next generation of Super Intelligence experiences while helping define a faster, more collaborative, AI-enabled approach to product development.

What You'll Do

Customer Discovery & Stakeholder Engagement

Work directly with customers, business leaders, and internal stakeholders to understand their challenges, workflows, and opportunities for improvement.
Lead discovery conversations, workshops, product demonstrations, and feedback sessions with both technical and nontechnical audiences.
Translate ambiguous business problems and customer requests into clear product opportunities, requirements, and actionable solutions.
Build strong relationships with stakeholders, manage expectations, and establish trust through clear communication and consistent follow-through.
Challenge assumptions, ask thoughtful questions, and help customers distinguish between what they initially request and what will actually solve their problem.
Communicate product recommendations, technical tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes effectively to senior business leaders and cross-functional teams.

Product Ownership & Execution

Take ownership of product initiatives from initial discovery and problem definition through prototyping, development, launch, and iteration.
Partner with engineers, designers, data specialists, and other product builders to translate customer needs into useful AI-powered experiences.
Define product requirements, user journeys, workflows, success metrics, and acceptance criteria.
Prioritize opportunities based on customer impact, business value, feasibility, and available resources.
Make thoughtful tradeoffs around scope, speed, usability, technical complexity, and long-term value.
Rapidly test ideas with customers, incorporate feedback, and refine solutions before investing heavily in development.
Use product analytics, customer feedback, and measurable outcomes to determine what to build, improve, or stop.
Drive alignment across teams and keep initiatives moving forward, even when requirements or priorities change.

AI Product Building & Technical Collaboration

Design, prototype, and help deliver AI-powered applications, intelligent agents, automations, and workflows that solve real customer problems.
Use large language models, agentic frameworks, APIs, code, and AI-assisted development tools to rapidly explore and validate product ideas.
Collaborate with engineering teams on solution design, architecture, integrations, and technical feasibility.
Experiment with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, agent orchestration, prompt and context design, and model selection.
Understand when AI is the appropriate solution and when traditional software or deterministic workflows may be more reliable.
Partner with engineers to define evaluations, test cases, and quality measures for AI-powered features, including accuracy, reliability, safety, and usefulness.
Identify technical limitations, troubleshoot issues, and help determine practical solutions.
Contribute directly to prototypes, automations, and technical workflows while working alongside experienced engineers on production implementations.
Help develop responsible AI experiences that account for security, privacy, customer data, and appropriate human oversight.

What We're Looking For

Typically 4–7 years of relevant experience in product development, technical product ownership, AI application development, product engineering, solutions engineering, forward-deployed engineering, or a related field. We value demonstrated capability and ownership over a specific number of years.
Meaningful experience working directly with customers, business stakeholders, or senior leaders to understand needs, gather feedback, influence decisions, and drive successful outcomes.
Demonstrated experience owning products or significant product initiatives from discovery through delivery and iteration.
Strong product judgment, including the ability to identify valuable problems, prioritize competing needs, and make informed tradeoffs.
Hands-on experience building or prototyping software applications, AI-powered tools, automations, or technical workflows.
Practical understanding of large language models and modern AI applications, including their capabilities, limitations, and real-world use cases.
Familiarity with AI agents, RAG, tool calling, prompt engineering, model evaluation, or related AI development techniques.
Working knowledge of programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript, along with APIs, data integration, and software development fundamentals.
Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and participate meaningfully in technical discussions without needing to own every aspect of implementation.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to engage customers and stakeholders at multiple organizational levels.
Experience navigating ambiguity, challenging assumptions constructively, and bringing structure to complex or loosely defined business problems.
A track record of taking initiative, experimenting with new approaches, and following through to deliver measurable results.

You May Be a Great Fit If

You enjoy working with customers as much as you enjoy building technology.
You can lead a conversation with a senior business stakeholder, uncover the real problem, and translate it into a practical product approach.
You've built or helped launch AI-powered applications and understand what it takes to move beyond a compelling demo.
You're comfortable challenging a customer's initial request when you believe there's a better way to address the underlying problem.
You understand AI well enough to recognize both its potential and its limitations.
You enjoy rapidly prototyping ideas, testing them with users, and refining them based on real feedback.
You can move between business strategy, product decisions, and technical implementation without losing sight of the customer.
You take ownership of outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks.
You thrive in environments where requirements aren't always clearly defined and where experimentation and adaptability are essential.
You're excited about helping shape the future of AI-native and Super Intelligence products.

Helpful, but Not Required

Experience at an AI-native company or building AI-first products.
Experience with enterprise B2B SaaS platforms or customer-facing enterprise software.
Experience with AI agent frameworks, vector databases, embedding models, evaluation tools, or multi-agent systems.
Familiarity with tools such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar AI development platforms.
Experience building and deploying applications using Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, or cloud services.
Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Product Engineer, or Technical Product Lead.
Familiarity with product collaboration tools such as Figma, Jira, Confluence, or Productboard.
Experience in government, defense, supply chain, procurement, risk management, compliance, or other complex enterprise environments.
A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, business, product management, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

How We Work

Our product development lifecycle is AI-enabled from beginning to end. We use AI to accelerate research, explore ideas, analyze information, generate and review code, create tests, document decisions, and improve the products we deliver.

We believe the most effective AI products are built by people who understand both the technology and the customers using it.

Our AI Product Builders are expected to work across disciplines, engage directly with stakeholders, test ideas early, and help teams move quickly from a customer problem to a useful working solution.

AI accelerates the process, but human judgment, customer understanding, and accountability remain essential.

We value curiosity, ownership, strong communication, thoughtful experimentation, and the ability to turn ambiguity into action.

What Success Looks Like

During your first year, you will:

Develop a strong understanding of Exiger's customers, platform, proprietary data, and AI capabilities.
Build trusted relationships with customers, business stakeholders, and internal product and engineering teams.
Independently lead customer discovery conversations and translate complex business challenges into actionable product opportunities.
Successfully guide AI-powered product initiatives from problem identification through launch and iteration.
Collaborate with engineering teams to design and deliver practical, reliable, and scalable AI-enabled experiences.
Demonstrate strong judgment in prioritizing product opportunities, evaluating technical approaches, and making informed tradeoffs.
Present product concepts, demonstrations, recommendations, and outcomes confidently to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
Help deliver AI-powered capabilities that achieve measurable customer adoption, efficiency improvements, or business value.
Contribute to Exiger's evolving Super Intell

You will apply applied-science rigor to turn complex customer and business problems into scalable, measurable AI solutions.

This role combines hands-on model development with cross-functional influence. You will work directly with ML Engineers, product managers, data teams, and business partners to define success measures, build and validate models, and improve their performance in production.

What You’ll Do

Build, evaluate, and improve ML and Generative AI models across LLMs, image and video generation, multimodal understanding, and agentic systems.
Develop data and evaluation strategies, including dataset curation, exploratory analysis, feature engineering, error analysis, ground truth, and offline evaluation.
Design and execute model experiments, benchmarking, and A/B tests to measure quality, safety, reliability, latency, scalability, and business impact.
Apply post-training, fine-tuning, retrieval, prompting, and other optimization techniques to improve model performance for production use cases.
Partner with product, engineering, data, and business teams to translate customer and business opportunities into technical requirements, success metrics, and deployable solutions.
Work with ML Engineers to deploy, monitor, and iterate on models in large-scale production environments.
Communicate technical recommendations and model results to stakeholders, while mentoring junior scientists and engineers on rigorous experimentation and responsible AI practices.

What You’ll Bring

Strong hands-on expertise in Python, machine learning, deep learning, NLP, information retrieval, computer vision, multimodal AI, and model evaluation.
Ability to translate customer and business needs into model designs, experiments, technical requirements, and scalable production solutions; communicate findings and tradeoffs clearly across product, engineering, data, business, and leadership teams.
Experience adapting open-weight models for specific business use cases through model selection, post-training, fine-tuning, and evaluation, including LLM-, vision-, multimodal-, and agent-based systems.

updated.title: Senior Staff Applied Scientist, Science Platform
updated.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It's built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet's largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Reddit brings people together around their interests, questions, and experiences. Our communities generate a rich and complex ecosystem of human activity, creating scientific challenges in understanding behavior, measuring impact, and anticipating change.

The Data Science Platform team builds the tools that enable a scientific understanding of Reddit. We develop Reddit's analytics agent, and the shared scientific capabilities and methods that allow data scientists and business partners to answer increasingly sophisticated questions.

We are looking for a senior technical lead who combines deep expertise in statistics, machine learning and causal inference with strong software engineering ability. You will establish the scientific direction for agentic analytics, causal inference, and forecasting, turning advances in research into reliable software used across the company.

As an Applied Scientist on the Science Platform team, you will work across the full development cycle: identifying important problems, evaluating research, implementing and validating methods, and shipping capabilities that others can use confidently. You will partner closely with software engineers and data scientists to build an analytics agent that can investigate questions, select appropriate methods, execute analyses, and communicate findings with clear assumptions and uncertainty.

Responsibilities:

Define the scientific roadmap for Data Science Platform across agentic analytics, causal inference and forecasting, identifying opportunities where advances in methodology can improve decision-making at scale across Reddit.
Research, evaluate, and implement emerging methods. Move quickly from research papers to working prototypes, validate their practical value, and develop successful approaches into maintained production capabilities.
Design and build our analytics agent's architecture and capabilities, including how the agent decomposes questions, selects scientific methods, uses data and analytical tools, checks assumptions, and produces reproducible results.
Build reusable causal inference tools that help teams estimate the effects of product changes, policies, and business decisions using observational data.
Develop shared forecasting capabilities for business and product metrics, including probabilistic predictions, hierarchical forecasts, and scenario analysis.
Create evaluation frameworks that measure the correctness and usefulness of agent-generated analyses. Build benchmarks, simulations, and automated checks that detect methodological errors, unsupported claims, and misleading interpretations.
Own the implementation of scientific methods in production software, writing robust Python code and partnering with engineers on libraries, APIs, data pipelines, observability, and system design.
Work with data scientists and business partners to identify recurring analytical needs and translate them into accessible platform capabilities, documentation, and workflows.
Influence technical and organizational strategy through clear scientific recommendations, mentor scientists and engineers, and share methodological advances internally and externally where appropriate.

Required Qualifications:

A doctorate in Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, or a related discipline; alternatively, a master's degree supported by comparable depth of expertise.
At least eight years of relevant industry work following a doctorate, or ten years with a master's degree, in applied science, data science, scientific software development, or related roles.
Deep knowledge of statistical inference and econometrics, with practical experience developing causal methods for observational data and evaluating the assumptions that make their conclusions credible.
Experience developing and deploying forecasting systems, including time series modeling, temporal validation, prediction intervals, and assessment of performance as underlying conditions change.
Strong software engineering skills, including substantial experience writing and maintaining production Python software. Familiarity with API design, automated testing, code review, version control, and operational monitoring.
A demonstrated ability to critically assess scientific literature, reproduce relevant findings, and turn promising methods into reliable software that solves practical problems.
Experience developing LLM applications or analytical agents, including tool use, code execution, and systematic evaluation of their outputs.
Clear communication of statistical assumptions, uncertainty, and technical tradeoffs to business audiences.
Experience developing other technical contributors through mentorship, design reviews, and collaboration across organizational boundaries.
The ability to make progress on ambiguous problems, prioritize consequential work, and deliver useful capabilities through rapid iteration.

Preferred Qualifications:

Publications, open-source contributions, or widely adopted internal tools in agentic analytics, causal inference, forecasting, or other related fields.
Experience building scientific libraries or platforms used by other data scientists, including interfaces that make sophisticated methods accessible to people with different levels of statistical expertise.
Experience building agents at scale that perform substantive analytical work, including retrieval of relevant data and context, selection of methods, execution of Python or SQL, and validation of findings.

Who We Are:

At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3,600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward-thinking environment.

We foster a workplace where everyone is valued, and employment decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and business needs—never on non-job-related factors or legally protected characteristics.

What We Offer:

🏢 Ways of working – Our hybrid model blends home with in-office experiences, making space for both.

📈 Grow with us – Learning, mentorship & career development programs.

💪 Your wellbeing matters – Health benefits, wellness perks & mental health support.

🤝 A team that cares – Diverse, inclusive, and globally connected.

💸 Fair pay & perks – Attractive salary, with performance-based rewards and family-friendly policies, plus the potential for equity depending on role and level.

Additional benefits may vary depending on the country where you work and the nature of your employment with Criteo.

For employees based in the US, certain roles at Criteo are eligible for additional rewards, including quarterly or annual bonus and restricted stock units. US-based employees receive access to healthcare, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, family forming and wellness benefits, Flexible Work financial support, learning opportunities, and a robust annual leave plan including volunteer time off and summer vacation days.
